न: न The twentieth consonant of the Nāgarī Alphabet, corresponding with the letter N.

न mfn. (नः-ना-नं) 1 Thin, spare. 2 Vacant, empty. 3 Identical, same, like. 4 Unvexed, unwearied. 5 Undivided, unbroken. m. (नः) 1 A Bauddha, a follower of Buddha. 2 Binding, tying. 3 One who is praised. 4 A name of GAṆEŚA. 5 War. 6 Giving, a gift. 7 Good, welfare, prosperity. 8 A jewel. f. (ना) 1 The navel. 2 A musical instrument. 3 Knowledge. ind. 1 No, not, a particle of prohibition. 2 A particle of comparison. 3 A particle of negation, annihilation, &c. E. नी to obtain, or नह to bind, &c., ड aff.
नःक्षुद्र: नःक्षुद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं) Small-nosed. E. नस् the nose, क्षुद्र small.
नंशुक: नंशुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Injurious, destructive. E. नश to destroy, णुकन् Uṇādi affix, and नुम् inserted.
नंष्टृ: नंष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) An injurer, injurious, destructive. E. नश to destroy, affix तृच्, and नुम् inserted.
नकुल: नकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Disgraced, rejected from a family or race. m. (-लः) 1 The Bengal mungoose, (Viverra ichneumon.) 2 A proper name, NAKULA, the fourth of the five Pāṇḍu princes. 3 A son. 4 A name of ŚIVA. f. (-ली) 1 Silk cotton tree. 2 Indian spikenard. 3 A sort of perfume: see शङ्खिनी. 4 Saffron. 5 The letter ह as used in the Tantras. E. न not, कुल race or heap, fem. affix ङीष्.
नकुलेश: नकुलेश m. (-शः) 1 A Bhairava, an attendant on or emanation from ŚIVA. 2 The letter ह as used mystically in Tantras. E. नकुल, and ईश master.
नकुलेष्टा: नकुलेष्टा f. (-ष्टा) A plant: see रास्ना. E. नकुल an ichneumon, and इष्ट wished; the mungoose, if wounded in a conflict with a poisonous snake, is supposed to prevent the effects of the venom by the use of this plant; also नकुलेष्टका.
नक्क: नक्क r. 10th cl. (नक्कयति) To destroy or annihilate.
नक्त: नक्त n. (-क्तं) Night. E. नज to be ashamed, तन् aff.
नक्तक: नक्तक m. (-कः) 1 Dirty or ragged cloth. 2 A rag, a wiper, a handkerchief, &c. E. नज to be ashamed or modest, affix तन्, and कन् added; also लक्तक.
नक्तचारिन्: नक्तचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Going or moving about at night. m. (-री) 1 A cat. 2 An owl. 3 A goblin. 4 A thief. E. नक्त by night, चर to go, णिनि aff.
नक्तञ्चर: नक्तञ्चर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Going at night. m. (-रः) 1 A goblin, a demon. 2 A tree, the Bdellium tree: see गुग्गुल. 3 An owl, 4 A thief. E. नक्तं by night, and चर who goes.
नक्तभोजन: नक्तभोजन n. (-नं) Supper. E. नक्त night, भोजन food.
नक्तम्: नक्तम् ind. By night, at night. E. नज to be ashamed, तन् aff.
नक्तमाल: नक्तमाल m. (-लः) A tree, (Galedupa arborea, Rox.) E. नक्तम् by night, अल to ornament, आङ् prefix, and अच् affix; blossoming at night.
नक्तमुखा: नक्तमुखा f. (-खा) Night. E. नक्तम् by night, उख to produce, affix क.
नक्तव्रत: नक्तव्रत n. (-तं) 1 Fasting by day and eating at night. 2 Any religious rite or obligation observed at night. E. नक्त, and व्रत vow.
नक्र: नक्र n. (-क्रं) The upper timber of a door-frame. nf. (-क्रं-क्रा) The nose. f. (-क्रा) A string of bees or wasps. m. (-क्रः) A crocodile. E. न not, क्रम to go, affix ड.
नक्रराज्: नक्रराज् m. (-राट्) or नक्रराज (-जः) A shark, but applied also differently: see ग्राह. E. नक्र a crocodile, and राज् or राज king.
नक्षत्र: नक्षत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 A star in general. 2 An asterism in the moon's path or lunar mansion, of which twenty-eight, distinct in name, figure, and number of stars, are enumerated; the Paurānic and popular enumeration of those constellations is twenty-seven; Abhijit, the twenty-seventh, being considered as formed of portions of the two contiguous asterisms, and not distinct from them. 2 A pearl. E. णक्ष to go, Uṇādi affix अत्रन् or क्षद Sautra root, to injure, or क्षर to drop, or क्षी to waste or decay, with the negative prefix, and ष्ट्रन् affix; deriv. irr.
नक्षत्रचक्र: नक्षत्रचक्र n. (-क्रं) 1 A particular diagram for astrological calculations. 2 The lunar asterisms collectively. E. नक्षत्र, and चक्र a circle.
नक्षत्रनेमि: नक्षत्रनेमि m. (-मिः) 1 The moon. 2 The pole-star. 3 VIṢṆU. f. (-मिः) The last of the asterisms, Revatī, containing thirtytwo stars. E. नक्षत्र a star, and नेमि circumference.
नक्षत्रप: नक्षत्रप m. (-पः) The moon. E. नक्षत्र, and प who cherishes.
नक्षत्रमाला: नक्षत्रमाला f. (-ला) 1 A necklace containing twenty-seven pearls. 2 The table of the asterisms in the moon's path. 3 A kind of dance. E. नक्षत्र a constellation, and माला a garland.
नक्षत्रेश: नक्षत्रेश m. (-शः) 1 The moon. 2 Camphor. E. नक्षत्र an asterism, and ईश lord.
नख: नख mn. (-खः-खी) A finger nail. m. (-खः) A part, a portion. nf. (-खं-खी) A perfume, a dried substance, of a brown colour, and of the shape of a nail; apparently, a dried shell fish, used as a perfume. f. (-खी) A vegetable perfume, different from the one above, though known by the same name, NAKHI. E. न privative, ख sense; or नह to bind, ख Uṇādi affix, the radical ह rejected.
नखकुट्ट: नखकुट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A barber. E. नख a nail, and कुट्ट who cuts; barbers in India trim the nails, &c.
नखखादिन्: नखखादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Who or what eats with nails or talons. E. नस्व, and खादिन् eating.
नखदारण: नखदारण m. (-णः) A falcon. E. नख a nail, and दारण tearing,
नखपद: नखपद n. (-दं) A scratch, the mark of a finger nail. E. नख, and पद a mark.
नखभिन्न: नखभिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Torn, or torn off with a nail. E. नख, and भिन्न divided.
नखमुच: नखमुच m. (-चः) A bow. E. नख a nail, मुच to let loose, क aff.
नखम्पच: नखम्पच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) What scalds the nail. E. नख, and पच to cook, खश aff.
नखर: नखर m. (-रः) A finger nail. f. (-री) A perfume: see नस्वी. E. न not, खन to go, and डर affix; or नख a nail, रा to go or be, affix ड.
नखरञ्जनी: नखरञ्जनी f. (-नी) A nail-parer. E. नख, and रञ्जनी beautifying.
नखरायुध: नखरायुध m. (-धः) 1 A lion. 2 Any beast of prey. 3 A cock. E. नखर a nail, आयुध a weapon.
नखलेखा: नखलेखा f. (-खा) A scratch. E. नख, and लेखा a line.
नखविलेख: नखविलेख m. (-खः) A scratch. E. नख, and विलेखा a mark.
नखविष्किर: नखविष्किर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) What tears or rends, (as a bird of prey, &c.) E. नख, and विष्किर what scatters.
नखव्रण: नखव्रण n. (-णं) A scratch. E. नख, and व्रण a wound.
नखशङ्ख: नखशङ्ख m. (-ङ्खः) A small shell. E. नख a nail, शङ्ख a shell, one as small as a nail.
नखांशु: नखांशु m. (-शुः) Elegance of the finger nails. E. नख, and अंशु a ray.
नखाङ्क: नखाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 1 A scratch, a mark of the nail. 2 A sort of perfume. E. नख a nail, and अङ्क a mark.
नखायुध: नखायुध m. (-धः) 1 A tiger. 2 A lion. 3 A cock. 4 Any beast or bird having talons. E. नख, and आयुध a weapon.
नखालि: नखालि m. (-लिः) A small shell. E. नख a nail, and आलि a line; also नखालिका.
नखाशिन्: नखाशिन् m. (-शी) An owl. E. नख a nail, and अशिन् who eats, using its claws in feeding.
नखिन्: नखिन् mfn. (-खी-खिनी-खि) Nailed, clawed, having nails or talons. E. नख, and इनि aff.
नग: नग m. (-गः) 1 A mountain. 2 A tree. E. न not, गम to go, affix ड, immoveable; or दह to burn, Uṇādi affix ग, ह rejected, and द changed to न.
नगज: नगज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Mountain, mountaineer. m. (-जः) An elephant. E. नग a mountain, and ज born.
नगनन्दिनी: नगनन्दिनी f. (-नी) The goddess DURGĀ. E. नग a mountain, and नन्दिनी a daughter, being in one of her characters the daughter of Himāla, the snowy Imaus personified.
नगपति: नगपति m. (-तिः) Himāla, the personified range of snowy mountains dividing India from Tartary, &c. E. नग mountain, and पति lord.
नगभिद्: नगभिद् m. (-द् or त्) 1 A plant, (Plectranthus scutellaroides.) 2 An axe, a crow. 2 INDRA. E. नग, and भिद् what breaks.
नगभू: नगभू mfn. (-भूः-भूः-भु) Mountain, mountaineer. E. नग, and भू born.
नगमूर्द्धन्: नगमूर्द्धन् m. (-र्द्धा) The crest or brow of a mountain. E. नग, and मूर्द्धन् forehead.
नगर: नगर mf. (-रं-री) A town, a city. E. नग a tree, or according to some, a mountain, रल् affix; having trees or houses like mountains.
नगरघात: नगरघात m. (-तः) An elephant. E. नगर a city, and घात who destroys or subverts.
नगरजन: नगरजन m. (-नः) Towns-folk, citizens. E. नगर, and जन people.
नगरस्थ: नगरस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) City, citizens. E. नगर, and स्थ who or what stays.
नगरस्वरूपिणी: नगरस्वरूपिणी f. (-णी) A species of the Anuṣṭubh metre.
नगरीवक: नगरीवक m. (-कः) A crow. E. नगरी, and वक a crane, the town-crane.
नगरोपान्त: नगरोपान्त m. (-न्तं) Suburb, skirts of the town. E. नग, and उपान्त vicinity.
नगरौषधि: नगरौषधि f. (-धिः) The plantain. E. नगर a city, and औषधि a medicament.
नगाटन: नगाटन m. (-नः) A monkey. E. नग a mountain, अट to go, affix ल्युट्.
नगाधिप: नगाधिप m. (-पः) Himāla: see नगपति. E. नग a mountain, and अधिप a lord; also नगाधिराज, &c.
नगाश्रथ: नगाश्रथ mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Living in or frequenting mountains. E. नग, and आश्रय abode.
नगोच्छ्राय: नगोच्छ्राय n. (-यं) The elevation of a mountain. E. नग, and उच्छ्राय heighth.
नगौकस्: नगौकस् m. (-काः) 1 A bird in general. 2 A lion. 3 A fabulous animal: see शरभ. 4 A crow. E. नग a tree, a mountain, and ओकस् a house or dwelling.
नग्न: नग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) Naked. m. (-ग्नः) 1 A naked mendicant. 2 A Bauddha. 3 A bard. f. (-ग्ना) A naked woman. E. नज to be ashamed, affix क्त.
नग्नक: नग्नक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Naked. E. कन् added to the last.
नग्नजित्: नग्नजित् m. (-जित्) The name of a king, father of one of KṚṢṆA'S wives. E. नग्न Bauddha, and जित् who conquers.
नग्नत्व: नग्नत्व n. (-त्वं) Nudity, nakedness. E. त्व added to नग्न; also with तल्, नग्नता.
नग्नहू: नग्नहू mn. (-हूः-हु) Ferment, a drug used to throw the mixture for spirituous liquor into fermentation. E. नग्न naked, and ह्वे to call, affix. क्विप्, what is called for by the barefaced, shameless, &c.
नग्नाट: नग्नाट m. (-टः) A naked man, but especially a kind of religious mendicant, who wanders about without clothes. 2 A Bauddha. 3 A Jain. E. नग्न naked, and अट who goes; also with कन् added नग्राटक.
नग्निका: नग्निका f. (-का) 1 A girl before menstruation or about ten years old. 2 A naked woman. E. नग्न naked, कन् added, and the fem. form: see नग्नक.
नग्नीकरण: नग्नीकरण n. (-णं) Stripping, undressing. E. नग्न, and करण making, च्चि augment.
नग्नीकृत: नग्नीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Undressed, stripped, naked. E. नग्न, and कृत made, च्चि aff.
नज: नज (ओ ई) ओनजी r. 6th cl. (नजते) also (इ, ओ) ओनजि r. 1st cl. (नञ्जते) To be ashamed, to be modest or bashful.
नञ्: नञ् ind. A particle of negation, prohibition, &c. (no, not:) see अ and न.
नट: नट r. 1st and 10th cls. (नटति नाटयति) 1 To dance, to dance as an actor, to act. 2 To drop or fall. 3 To shake, to move slightly. 4 To injure. 5 To shine.

नट m. (-टः) 1 A dancer, a mime, an actor, a Nut, &c. in modern times: in caste, the son of a degraded Kṣatriya by a woman of the second caste. 4 A sort of reed, (Arundo tibialis, or latterly called A. karka, Roxburgh's Catalogue;) also नड and नल. 5 A subordinate mode of music. f. (-टा) A sort of shrub, (Cæsalpinia bonduccella.) (-टी) 1 A medicinal plant: see नली. 2 A whore. 3 A Nach girl, a dancer, an actress. 4 Red arsenick: see नली. 5 A Rāgiṇī. E. नट to dance, affix अच्, and टाप् or ङीष्; otherwise, नश to destroy, Uṇādi affix डट, &c.
नटन: नटन n. (-नः) The art or act of dancing, pantomime, &c. E. नट to dance, affix ल्युट्.
नटनारायण: नटनारायण m. (-णः) A Rāga or mode of music, according to some, the sixth, or to others, a subdivision of Dīpaka or of Megha. E. नट, and नारायण VIṢṆU: the supreme with dancers, &c.
नटमण्डन: नटमण्डन n. (-नं) Yellow orpiment. E. नट an actor, and मण्डन adorning; dying theatrical raiment.
नटवर: नटवर m. (-रः) A chief dancer or actor. E. नट, and वर best.
नटसज्ञक: नटसज्ञक m. (-कः) 1 Yellow orpiment. 2 An actor, a dancer, &c. E. नट an actor, सज्ञा a name, affix कन्.
नटश्रेष्ठ: नटश्रेष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A chief or excellent dancer or actor. E. नट, and श्रेष्ठ best.
नटान्तिका: नटान्तिका f. (-का) Shame, modesty. E. नट dancing, and अन्त destroying, affix कन् and टाप्; it is also read नटान्धिका.
नटेश्वर: नटेश्वर m. (-रः) A name of ŚIVA. E. नट a dancer, and ईश्वर a deity, the god of the dancers.
नड: नड r. 1st cl. (नडति) To be thick or impervious. r. 10th cl. (नडयति) To fall off or from.
नड m. (-डः) 1 A sort of reed, (Arundo tibialis, or karka;) also नल. 2 A particular tribe whose employment is making a sort of glass bracelets. E. नड to be thick, affix अच्.
नडकीय: नडकीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Abounding in reeds, (a field, &c.) E. नड a reed, छ affix, and कुक् augment.
नडप्राय: नडप्राय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Abounding in reeds. E. नड, and प्राय abundance.
नडमीन: नडमीन m. (-नः) A small fish, a kind of sprat haunting reedy places. E. नड a reed, and मीन a fish.
नडसंहति: नडसंहति f. (-तिः) A quantity of reeds. E. नड, and संहति assemblage; also any analogous compound.
नडह: नडह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Lovely, beautiful, desirable. E. नड here said to be mental anxiety, derived from नड to fall off or from, हन to destroy, affix ड.
नड्या: नड्या f. (-ड्या) A quantity of reeds. E. नड a reed, affix यत्.
नड्वत्: नड्वत् mfn. (-ड्वान्-ड्वती-ड्वत्) Reedy, abounding in reeds. E. नड, and मतुप् aff.
नड्वल: नड्वल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Reedy, abounding in reeds. E. नड, and ड्वलच् aff.
नड्वाभू: नड्वाभू f. (-भूः) A house or hut of reeds. E. नड्व, and भू being, with आङ् prefixed.
नत: नत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bent, bowed, reclining. 2 Crooked, curved. n. (-तं) 1 The are or distance of any planet from the zenith. 3 A plant or its root: see तगर and तगरमूल. E. नम to bow or bend, affix क्त.
नतनाडिका: नतनाडिका f. (-का) Any hour of birth, after noon or before midnight. E. नत, and नाडिका a period of twenty-four minutes.
नतनासिक: नतनासिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Flat-nosed. E. नत bowed, and नासिक the nose.
नतभाग: नतभाग m. (-गः) (In Astronomy,) Zenith distance. E. नत, and भाग a part.
नतभ्रू: नतभ्रू mfn. (-भ्रूः-भ्रूः-भ्रू) Frowning. E. नत, and भ्रू the brow.
नतमुख: नतमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Down-faced, looking down. E. नत, and मुख the face.
नतमूर्द्धन्: नतमूर्द्धन् mfn. (-र्द्धा-र्द्धा-र्द्ध) Looking down, hanging down the head. E. नत, मूर्द्धन् the forehead.
नतांश: नतांश m. (-शं) Zenith distance, (in Astronomy.) E. नत, and अंश a degree.
नताङ्ग: नताङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Bent, curved, bowed, stooping. f. (-ङ्गी) A woman. E. नत, and अङ्ग the body.
नति: नति f. (-तिः) 1 Bending, bowing, stooping. 2 Curvature, crookedness. E. नम to bow, क्तिन् aff.
नद: नद r. 1st and 10th cls. (नदति नादयति) 1 To speak or emit sound. 2 To shine: see खद. With वि and अनु, To fill with noise or sound; (दु इ,) दुनदि r. 1st cl. (नन्दति) 1 To thrive, to be prosperous. 2 (Usually with आङ् prefixed,) To be happy, to be pleased or delighted. With अभि prefixed, 1 To wish for. 2 To acknowledge or confess. With प्रति, To be thankful.

नद m. (-दः) A river, applied only to one of which the personification is male, as the Brahmaputra, Śoṇa, Indus, &c. f. (-दी) A river in general; the common personification of rivers being female. E. नद to sound, affix अट्, fem. affix ङीप्.
नदत्: नदत् mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्) Sounding, making a sound. E. नद to sound, शतृ aff.
नदनदीपति: नदनदीपति m. (-तिः) The sea. E. नद, and नदी, and पति lord.
नदनु: नदनु m. (-नुः) 1 A cloud. 2 A lion. E. नद to sound, अनुङ् Uṇādi aff.
नदीकान्त: नदीकान्त m. (-न्तः) 1 The ocean. 2 A sort of tree, (Barringtonia acutangula:) see इज्जल. 3 A small tree, (Vitex negundo.) f. (-न्ता) 1 A creeper. 2 The rose apple, (Eugenia jambu.) 3 A shrub, (Leea hirta.) E. नदी a river, कान्त loved.
नदीकूल: नदीकूल n. (-लः) The bank or shore of a river. E. नदी a river, कूल a bank.
नदीकूलप्रिय: नदीकूलप्रिय m. (-यः) A sort of reed, (Calamus rotang.) E. नदीकूल a river bank, and प्रिय fond of; growing on the banks of rivers.
नदीज: नदीज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Aquatic, water-born. n. (-जं) 1 Antimony. 2 A lotus. m. (-जः) 1 A sort of tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.) 2 The marshy date tree. 3 A name of BHĪṢMA. E. नदी a river, and ज born.
नदीज्ञ: नदीज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) One who knows the course of rivers, &c. E. नदी, and ज्ञ who knows.
नदीतरस्थान: नदीतरस्थान n. (-नं) A Ghāt, a landing place, a ferry. E. नदी a river, तर crossing, and स्थान place; also नदीतरस्थल.
नदीतीर: नदीतीर n. (-रं) The bank of a river. E. नदी, and तीर a bank.
नदीन: नदीन m. (-नः) 1 The ocean. 2 The god of water, VARUṆA. E. नदी a river, and इन lord.
नदीमातृक: नदीमातृक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Watered by rivers, (land, rice, &c.) E. नदी a river, मातृ a mother, कन् aff.
नदीरय: नदीरय m. (-यः) The stream or current of a river. E. नदी, and रय going.
नदीवङ्क: नदीवङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) The bend or arm of a river. E. नदी a river, and वङ्क a bend.
नदीवेग: नदीवेग m. (-गः) The stream or current of a river. E. नदी, and वेग speed.
नदीवेला: नदीवेला f. (-ला) The current or stream of a river. E. नदी, and वेला flow.
नदीष्ण: नदीष्ण mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं) 1 Bathing, &c. in a river. 2 One who knows rivers, their depth, course, &c. E. नदी river, स्ना to bathe, ड affix; and स्न changed to ष्ण.
नदीसर्ज: नदीसर्ज्ज m. (-र्ज्जः) A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.) E. नदी a river, and सर्ज्ज the Śāl tree.
नदीसर्ज्ज: नदीसर्ज्ज m. (-र्ज्जः) A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.) E. नदी a river, and सर्ज्ज the Śāl tree.
नदेयी: नदेयी f. (-यी) A plant, (Premna herbacea, Rox.) E. नदी a river, ढक्, affix; also नादेयी.
नद्ध: नद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Bound, tied. 2 Drawn up, raised. E. नह to tye, affix क्त.
नद्धी: नद्धी f. (-द्धी) A leather cord, a thong. E. नह to bind, ष्ट्रन् aff.
ननान्दृ: ननान्दृ f. (-न्दा) A husband's sister. E. न negative, नन्द to please, ऋत् Uṇādi affix; also the penultimate being made long, ननान्दृ.
ननु: ननु ind. 1 A particle of interrogation, (how, what.) 2 Of affirmation, (certainly.) 3 Of assent. 4 A consolatory and kind expression. 5 A vocative particle, (ho, hola,) or one implying kindness, conciliation, (pray, good friend, &c.) 6 An inceptive particle, implying doubt or dissent, (may be, but, on the other hand.) 7 A responsive particle. 8 A particle of reproach. E. न negative, नुद to send or command, affix डु.
ननुच: ननुच ind. An inceptive particle, implying doubt, dissent, or contradiction. E. ननु as above, and च particle.
नन्तव्य: नन्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be saluted, to be revered or honoured. E. नम to salute, तव्य aff.
नन्द: नन्द mf. (-न्दः-न्दी) Happiness, pleasure, felicity. m. (-न्दः) 1 One of KUVERA'S nine inestimable gems or treasure. 2 The cowherd NANDA, the foster father of KṚṢṆA. 3 A name of VIṢṆU. 4 A prince, the son of MAHĀNANDI. 5 A flute, one eleven inches long. f. (-न्दा) 1 An earthen water jar. 2 The first, sixth, or eleventh day of the fortnight. 3 Prosperity, increase. 4 A husband's sister. f. (-न्दी) INDRA'S garden. f. (-न्दा or -न्दी) A name of DURGĀ. E. नदि to be prosperous or happy, affix अच् and टाप्.
नन्दक: नन्दक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Rejoicing, making happy or delighted. 2 Cherishing or rearing a family. m. (-कः) 1 Happiness, pleasure. 2 The sword of KṚṢṆA. 3 The foster father of KṚṢṆA. 4 A frog. E. नदि to make happy, affix वुन्.
नन्दकि: नन्दकि f. (-किः) Long pepper. E. नदि to delight, affix कि.
नन्दकिन्: नन्दकिन् m. (-की) KṚṢṆA. E. नन्दक, and इनि aff.
नन्दगोपिता: नन्दगोपिता f. (-ता) A plant: see रास्ना.
नन्दथु: नन्दथु m. (-थुः) Happiness, felicity. E. नदि to be happy, affix अथुच्.
नन्दन: नन्दन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Delighting, rejoicing, making pleased or happy. m. (-नः) 1 A son. 2 A frog. 3 VIṢṆU. n. (-नं) INDRA'S pleasure ground, elysium. 2 A species of the Dhṛti metre. f. (-ना) A daughter, E. नदि to be or make happy, affix ल्यु.
नन्दनन्दन: नन्दनन्दन m. (-नः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. नन्द, and नन्दन a son; the son of NANDA.
नन्दनन्दिनी: नन्दनन्दिनी f. (-नी) A name of DURGĀ. E. नन्द the cowherd NANDA, and नन्दिनी a daughter.
नन्दन्त: नन्दन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 A son. 2 A friend. 3 A prince. E. नदि to make happy, झच् Uṇādi aff.
नन्दनमाला: नन्दनमाला f. (-ला) A chaplet or garland made by KṚṢṆA. E. नन्दन delighting, माला a garland.
नन्दयत्: नन्दयत् mfn. (-यन्-यती-यत) Making happy, delighting. E. नदि to be happy, causal v. शतृ aff.
नन्दयन्त: नन्दयन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ती-न्तं) Making happy, rejoicing, delighting. E. नदि in the causal form, with झच् aff.
नन्दपाल: नन्दपाल m. (-लः) A name of VARUṆA. E. नन्द KUVERA'S treasure, and पाल who guards.
नन्दपुत्री: नन्दपुत्री f. (-त्री) DURGĀ. E. नन्द the cowherd NANDA, and पुत्री a daughter; the goddess becoming incarnate, as the infant daughter of NANDA.
नन्दात्मज: नन्दात्मज m. (-जः) KṚṢṆA. f. (-जा) DURGĀ. E. नन्द as above, and आत्मज offspring: see नन्दनन्दन; also नन्दपुत्र, नन्दसुत, &c.
नन्दि: नन्दि mn. (-न्दिः-न्दि) 1 Gambling, gaming. 2 Happiness. m. (-न्दिः) 1 One of ŚIVA'S principal attendants. 2 The speaker of the prologue or prelude to a drama. 3 One who pronounces a benediction. E. नदि to make happy, and इन् Uṇādi aff.
नन्दिक: नन्दिक m. (-कः) Tūn, a tree, the wood of which resembles mahogany, and is used for furniture, &c. (Cedrela tunna.) f. (-का) 1 INDRA'S garden or pleasure ground. 2 An earthen water pot. 3 The first, sixth, or eleventh day of a fortnight. E. नन्द, with कन् or ठक् aff.
नन्दिकेश्वर: नन्दिकेश्वर m. (-रः) 1 One of ŚIVA'S chief attendants. 2 An inferior Purāṇa. E. नन्दिक INDRA'S garden, and ईश्वर master.
नन्दिघोष: नन्दिघोष m. (-षः) 1 The car of ARJUNA. 2 The acclaim or proclamation of a panegyrist or herald. E. नन्दि happy, and घोष sound.
नन्दिन्: नन्दिन् mfn. (-न्दी-न्दिनी-न्दि) Happy, rejoiced, delighted. m. (-न्दी) 1 The name of one of ŚIVA'S chamberlains, and chief attendants. 2 The Indian fig tree. 3 Pārspīpal, (Hibiscus populneoides.) 4 The speaker of the prelude or prologue to a drama. f. (-न्दिनी) 1 A name of the goddess PĀRVATĪ. 2 GAṄGĀ, the river goddess. 3 A husband's sister. 4 A fabulous cow, related to the cow of plenty, and the property of the sage VAŚIṢṬHA. 5 The Alakanandā river. 6 The mother of the writer VYĀḌI. E. नन्द happiness, इनि aff.
नन्दिनीतनय: नन्दिनीतनय m. (-यः) A name of VYĀḌI, author of a vocabulary. E. नन्दिनी as above, and तनय a son; also similar compounds, as नन्दिनीसुत, नन्दिनीपुत्त्र, &c.
नन्दिवर्द्धन: नन्दिवर्द्धन m. (-नः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 The last day of either half of the month, the full or new moon. 3 A son. 4 A friend. E. नन्दि happiness, &c. and वर्द्धन increasing.
नन्दिवृक्ष: नन्दिवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) The Tūn tree. E. नन्दि pleasure, and वृक्ष a tree: also ङीष् being added to नन्दि, नन्दीवृक्ष; or with कन् added, नन्दिवृक्षक.
नन्दीट: नन्दीट m. (-टः) A bald-headed man. E. नन्दि ŚIVA'S bald-headed attendant, and अट who resembles, deriv. irr.
नन्दीश: नन्दीश m. (-शः) 1 A name of NANDĪ, ŚIVA'S attendant. 2 A name of ŚIVA. 3 A species of musical rhythm. E. नन्दी INDRA'S garden, or नन्दि a proper name, ईश master.
नन्दीश्वर: नन्दीश्वर m. (-रः) A name of ŚIVA, &c.: see the last. E. नन्दि ŚIVA'S chamberlain, and ईश्वर master.
नन्दीसरस्: नन्दीसरस् n. (-रः) A lake or pond in INDRA'S garden. E. नन्दी the garden, सरस् a piece of water.
नन्द्यावर्त: नन्द्यावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 A sort of temple. 2 A tree, (Tabernæmontana coronaria:) see तगर. 3 A peculiar diagram. E. नन्दी happiness, आवर्त्त abode.
नन्द्यावर्त्त: नन्द्यावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) 1 A sort of temple. 2 A tree, (Tabernæmontana coronaria:) see तगर. 3 A peculiar diagram. E. नन्दी happiness, आवर्त्त abode.
नन्नम्यमान: नन्नम्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Bending or bowing very low. E. नम to bow, intens. form, शानच् aff.
नपुंसक: नपुंसक mn. (-कः-कं) 1 A eunuch. 2 An impotent or imbecile man. 3 The neuter gender. E. न not, पुंसक a male.
नप्तृ: नप्तृ m. (-प्ता) A grandson. f. (-प्त्री) A granddaughter. E. न not, पत to fall, तृच् Uṇādi affix; propping or sustaining the family.
नभ: नभ m. (-भः) 1 The month Śrāvaṇa. 2 Æther, atmosphere. f. (-भा) 1 A spitting pot. 2 The city of the sun. E. नह to bind, affix भ; see नभस्.
नभःक्रान्तिन्: नभःक्रान्तिन् m. (-न्ति) A lion. E. नभस् a cloud, and क्रान्तिन् who goes; whose shape is seen in the clouds.
नभःप्राण: नभःप्राण m. (-णः) Air, wind. E. नभस् atmosphere, and प्राण life or breath.
नभःसद्: नभःसद् m. (-सद्) A deity. E. नभस् heaven, and सद् who travels, from सद to go, with क्विप् aff.
नभःसरित्: नभःसरित् f. (-रित्) The celestial Ganges. E. नभस् heaven, and सरित् a river.
नभःस्थ: नभःस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Celestial, aerial, heavenly, etherial. E. नभस्, and स्थ what stays; also नभस्स्थ.
नभःस्थित: नभःस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) A biding in heaven or in the sky. m. (-तः) A division of the infernal regions, a hell. E. नभस् atmosphere, and स्थित a staying; also नभस्स्थित.
नभश्चक्षुस्: नभश्चक्षुस् m. (-क्षुः) The sun. E. नभस् heaven, and चक्षुस् the eye.
नभश्चमस: नभश्चमस m. (-सः) 1 The moon. 2 A variegated cake. 3 Conjuring. E. नभस् heaven, and चमस a sort of ladle, &c.
नभश्चर: नभश्चर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Going in the air or heaven. m. (-रः) 1 A bird. 2 A Vidyādhara or demigod so called. 3 A cloud. 4 Air, wind. E. नभस् heaven, and चर who goes.
नभस्: नभस् m. (-भाः) 1 The month Śrāvaṇa, (July-August.) 2 A cloud. 3 The rains, or rainy season. 4 Smell. 5 The fibres in the root of the lotus. 6 A bird. 7 A grey-headed man. n. (-भः) Sky, atmosphere, æther or heaven. E. नभ to injure, to be annihilated, (at the end of the world,) Uṇādi affix असुन्, or नह to bind, and भ substituted for ह.
नभस: नभस n. (-सं) Heaven, sky, &c. see the last. E. नभ as above, Uṇādi affix असच्.
नभसङ्गम: नभसङ्गम m. (-मः) A bird. E. नभस heaven, गम to go, affix खच.
नभस्तल: नभस्तल m. (-लः) The atmosphere. E. नभस् sky, and तल below.
नभस्य: नभस्य m. (-स्यः) The month Bhādra, (August-September.) E. नभस् a cloud or rain, and यत् aff.
नभस्वत्: नभस्वत् m. (-स्वान्) Air, wind. E. नभस्, and मतुप् aff.
नभाक: नभाक n. (-कं) Darkness. E. नभ to injure, आक Uṇādi aff.
नभोगज: नभोगज m. (-जः) A cloud. E. नभस् sky, and गज an elephant.
नभोगति: नभोगति f. (-तिः) Flying, soaring, going in the air. E. नभस् sky and गति going.
नभोदुह: नभोदुह m. (-हः) A cloud. E. नभस् rain, (-दुह) to milk, affix क.
नभोद्वीप: नभोद्वीप m. (-पः) A cloud. E. नभस् rain, द्वीप an island.
नभोधूम: नभोधूम m. (-मः) A cloud. E. नभस् sky, and भूम smoke.
नभोनदी: नभोनदी f. (-दी) The celestial Ganges. E. नभस् heaven, and नदी a river.
नभोमणि: नभोमणि m. (-णिः) The sun. E. नभस् sky, मणि a gem.
नभोम्बुप: नभोऽम्बुप m. (-पः) The Cātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucos.) E. नभस् sky, अम्बु water, and प who drinks.
नभोरजस्: नभोरजस् n. (-जः) Darkness. E. नभस् sky, and रजस् dust.
नभोरेणु: नभोरेणु f. (-णुः) Fog, mist, vapour. E. नभस् sky, and रेणु thin dust.
नभोलय: नभोलय m. (-यः) Smoke. E. नभस् sky, and लय abode.
नभोलिह्: नभोलिह् mfn. (-लिट्) Lofty, towering, rising to the clouds. E. नभस्, and लिह् what touches.
नभ्य: नभ्य mfn. (-भ्यः-भ्या-भ्यं) Relating to the nave of a wheel, resembling it, &c. E. नभ for नाभि, and यत् aff.
नभ्राज्: नभ्राज् m. (-भ्राट्) A cloud. E. न negative, भ्राज to shine, affix क्विप्.
नम: नम r. 1st cl. (नमति) To bow, to pay obeisance. r. 10th cl. (नमयति-नामयति) To bend, to bow: see णम.
नमत्: नमत् mfn. (-मन्-मन्ती-मत्) Bending, stooping, bowed. E. नम to bow, शतृ aff.
नमत: नमत m. (-तः) 1 A master, a lord. 2 An actor, a mime. 3 A cloud. E. नम to bow or bend, Uṇādi affix अतच्.
नमयत्: नमयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Bending, directing downward, declining. E. नम to bow. r. 10th cl. शतृ aff.
नमस्: नमस् ind. 1 Gift, present. 2 Bowing, bending, salutation, obeisance. 3 An inarticulate cry. 4 The term used in connexion with the name of a deity in the fifth case to signify veneration, as रामाय नमः salutation, glory or reverence to RĀMA. E. नम to bend, and affix असुन्.
नमस: नमस m. (-सः) Agreement, concord. E. नम to bow, affix कसच्.
नमसित: नमसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Reverenced, respected, worshipped. E. नमस् bowing, क्यप् affix, and क्त added, य rejected: see नमस्यित.
नमस्कार: नमस्कार m. (-रः) 1 Respectful or reverential address or salutation. 2 A sort of poison. f. (-री) A sensitive plant. E. नमस् bowing, and कार making, fem. affix ङीप्.
नमस्कृत्वा: नमस्कृत्वा ind. Having saluted reverentially. E. नमस्, and कृत्वा having made.
नमस्य: नमस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Venerable, respectable, entitled to salutation or civility. f. (-स्या) Reverence, respect, worship, adoration. E. नमस् respect, क्यप् aff.
नमस्यत्: नमस्यत् mfn. (-स्यन्-स्यन्ती-स्यत्) Saluting reverentially, bowing to, paying adoration. E. नमस् nominal verb, to bow, शतृ aff.
नमस्यित: नमस्यित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Reverenced, respected, worshipped. E. नमस् respect, affix क्यप्, and the participial affix क्त; also नमसित.
नमित: नमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Bowed, making salutation or obeisance. 2 Bowed, bent down. E. नम to bend, causal form, affix क्त.
नमुचि: नमुचि m. (-चिः) 1 The deity of love. 2 A demon so named. E. न negative, मुच to loose, and कि aff.
नमुचिसूदन: नमुचिसूदन m. (-नः) A name of INDRA. E. नमुचि the demon, and सूदन destroyer; also similar names, as नमुचिद्विष्, &c.
नमेरु: नमेरु m. (-रुः) The seed of the Elæocarpus. E. न not, मेरु the mountain Meru.
नमोगुरु: नमोगुरु m. (-रुः) A spiritual teacher. E. नमस् reverence, and गुरु a teacher.
नम्ब: नम्ब r. 1st cl. (नम्बति) To go, to move.
नम्र: नम्र mfn. (-म्रः-म्रा-म्रं) Crooked, curved, bent, bowed. E. नम to bow, affix र.
नम्रक: नम्रक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Bent or bowed, stooping. E. कन् added to the last.
नम्रमुख: नम्रमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Looking down, having the head bent. E. नम्र, and मुख the face.
नम्रमूर्ति: नम्रमूर्त्ति mfn. (-र्त्तिः-र्त्तिः-र्त्ति) Bending down, stooping, bowed. E. नम्र, and मूर्त्ति form.
नम्रमूर्त्ति: नम्रमूर्त्ति mfn. (-र्त्तिः-र्त्तिः-र्त्ति) Bending down, stooping, bowed. E. नम्र, and मूर्त्ति form.
नम्राङ्ग: नम्राङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Bent, bowed, stooping. E. नम्र, and अङ्ग the body.
नय: नय r. 1st cl. (-नयते) To go, to move: see णय and णी.

नय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Fit, right, proper. 2 Leading, conducting, (who or what does so.) m. (-यः) 1 Guiding, directing, (literally or figuratively, as in morals, &c.) 2 Polity, civil and military government. 3 The theological part of the Vedas. 4 A sort of dice or men for playing with. 5 A guide, a conductor. E. नय to go, affix घञ्, or णी to guide, &c. affix अच्.
नयत्: नयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 1 Leading, guiding. 2 Tending or conducing to. 3 Informing, certifying, giving in evidence. 4 Obtaining. E. णी to obtain, शतृ aff.
नयन: नयन n. (-नं) 1 The eye. 2 Leading, guiding, (literally or figuratively.) 3 Attaining, obtaining. 4 Bringing. f. (-ना) The pupil of the eye. E. णी to guide, affix ल्युट्.
नयनवारि: नयनवारि n. (-रि) Tears. E. नयन, and वारि water.
नयनामोषिन्: नयनामोषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Sight-stealing, blinding. E. नयन, and आमोषिन् what steals.
नयनोत्सव: नयनोत्सव m. (-वः) 1 A lamp. 2 Any lovely or desired object. E. नयन the eye, and उत्सव a festival.
नयनोपान्त: नयनोपान्त m. (-न्तः) The outer angle or canthus of the eye. E. नयन, and उपान्त extremity.
नयनौषध: नयनौषध m. (-धः) Green sulphate of iron, or the salt in a state of partial decomposition by exposure to the atmosphere. E. नयन the eye, and औषध a medicament, being used as a collyrium.
नयपीठी: नयपीठी f. (-ठी) The board or cloth on which dice or men are played. E. नय dice, पीठी a stool.
नयप्रयोग: नयप्रयोग m. (-गः) Policy, political address. E. नय, and प्रयोग application.
नयविशारद: नयविशारद m. (-दः) A politician, a statesman. E. नय, and विशारद skilled in.
नयसिद्धि: नयसिद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Political success, accomplishing any thing by good management. E. नय, and सिद्धि success.
नर: नर m. (-रः) 1 Man, individually or generally. 2 The Eternal, the divine imperishable spirit pervading the universe. 3 A name of ARJUNA. 4 VIṢṆU. 5 A gnomon. 6 A man or piece at chess, draughts, &c. 7 A Muni, an incarnation of VIṢṆU. n. (-रं) A fragrant grass, commonly Rāmkapūr. f. (-री) Woman in general: see नारी. E. नृ to lead or guide, affix अच्.
नरक: नरक mn. (-कः-कं) Hell, the infernal regions, including a number of places of torture of various descriptions. m. (-कः) The name of a Daitya or demon. E. नृ to guide or lead, affix वुन्, whither the wicked are conducted: sometimes read नारक.
नरककुण्ड: नरककुण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A well or pit in Tartarus, eighty-six such are enumerated. E. नरक, and कुण्ड a pit.
नरकजित्: नरकजित् m. (-जित्) A name of VIṢṆU. E. नरक the demon, and जित् subduing.
नरकदेवता: नरकदेवता f. (-ता) Misfortune, personified as a goddess. E. नरक, and देवता divinity.
नरकस्थ: नरकस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Living or being in Tartarus, who or what is there. f. (-स्था) The river of hell. E. नरक hell, स्थ who stays or abides, fem. affix टाप्.
नरकान्तक: नरकान्तक m. (-कः) VIṢṆU. E. नरक hell, and अन्तक destroyer.
नरकामय: नरकामय m. (-यः) The soul after death. E. नरक hell, and आमव sickness.
नरकीलक: नरकीलक m. (-कः) The murderer of his spiritual preceptor. E. नर mankind, and कील a stake, affix कन्.
नरङ्ग: नरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Pimples on the face. n. (-ङ्गं) The penis. E. नृ to guide or lead, Uṇādi affix अङ्ग.
नरदेव: नरदेव m. (-वः) A sovereign, a king. E. नर a man, and देव a deity.
नरनारायण: नरनारायण m. dual. (-णौ) Two sages, incarnations of VIṢṆU, and born again, as KṚṢṆA and ARJUNA. E. नर, and नारायण, each severally the name of a sage.
नरपति: नरपति m. (-तिः) A king, a sovereign prince. E. नर man, पति lord.
नरप्रिय: नरप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Favourable or friendly to mankind. E. नर, and प्रिय fond of.
नरभू: नरभू f. (-भूः) Bharata Varṣa, India, or the central part of the known continent. 2 The birth or birthplace of men. E. नर man, and भू land; also नरभूमि f. (-मिः)
नरमानिनी: नरमानिनी f. (-नी) A woman who has a beard. E. नर a man, मन to regard or think, and णिनि affix; also with कन् affix in the feminine form, नरमानिका; these words are also written नरमालिनी, &c.
नरमाला: नरमाला f. (-ला) A string or girdle of skulls. E. नर, and माला a garland.
नरमालिनी: नरमालिनी f. (-नी) A woman with a beard. E. नर a man, माला a necklace, इनि aff.
नरमेध: नरमेध m. (-धः) A human sacrifice. E. नर, and मेध a sacrifice.
नरवाहन: नरवाहन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Borne or carried by men. m. (-नः) A name of KUVERA. E. नर a man, and वाहन a vehicle.
नरवाहिन्: नरवाहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) Carried by men, (a vehicle.) E. नर, and वाहिन् what bears.
नरविष्वण: नरविष्वण m. (-णः) An imp or goblin. E. नर man, and विष्वण who devours.
नररूप: नररूप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) Having the form of man. n. (-पं) The human form. E. नर, and रूप form.
नररूपिन्: नररूपिन् mfn. (-पी-पिणी-पि) Having the human form. E. नररूप, and इनि aff.
नरसिंह: नरसिंह m. (-हः) 1 VIṢṆU in his fourth Avatāra or descent, the lion-headed man. 2 A chief, a man of eminence or power. E. नर a man, and सिंह a lion.
नरहरि: नरहरि m. (-रिः) VIṢṆU in his fourth Avatar: see the last. E. नर, and हरि a lion.
नराधम: नराधम m. (-मः) A low or vile man, a wretch. E. नर, and अधम low.
नराधारा: नराधारा f. (-रा) The earth. E. नर man, आधार receptacle.
नराधिप: नराधिप m. (-पः) A king. E. नर, and अधिप ruler.
नरान्तक: नरान्तक m. (-कः) 1 Death. 2 A Rākṣasa, a son of RĀVAṆA. E. नर, and अन्तक destroyer.
नरायण: नरायण m. (-णः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. नर man, and अयण going: see नारायण.
नरेन्द्र: नरेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) 1 A king, an anointed sovereign. 2 A dealer in antidotes, a juggler. E. नर a man, इन्द्र chief.
नरेश: नरेश m. (-शः) A king. E. नर, and ईश master.
नरेश्वर: नरेश्वर m. (-रः) A king. E. नर, and ईश्वर a sovereign.
नर्तक: नर्त्तक m. (-कः) 1 An actor, a mime. 2 A juggler, a dancer, a player of any description. 3 A bard, a herald. 4 An elephant. 5 A reed, (Arundo karka, Rox.) 5 A peacock. f. (-की) 1 An actress, female dancer or singing girl. 2 A female elephant. 3 A peahen. E. नृत to dance or act, ष्वुन् aff.
नर्त्तक: नर्त्तक m. (-कः) 1 An actor, a mime. 2 A juggler, a dancer, a player of any description. 3 A bard, a herald. 4 An elephant. 5 A reed, (Arundo karka, Rox.) 5 A peacock. f. (-की) 1 An actress, female dancer or singing girl. 2 A female elephant. 3 A peahen. E. नृत to dance or act, ष्वुन् aff.
नर्तन: नर्त्तन n. (-नं) Dancing, gesticulating, acting. E. नृत to dance, &c. affix ल्युट्.
नर्त्तन: नर्त्तन n. (-नं) Dancing, gesticulating, acting. E. नृत to dance, &c. affix ल्युट्.
नर्तनप्रिय: नर्त्तनप्रिय m. (-यः) A peacock. E. नर्त्तन dancing, and प्रिय fond of.
नर्त्तनप्रिय: नर्त्तनप्रिय m. (-यः) A peacock. E. नर्त्तन dancing, and प्रिय fond of.
नर्तित: नर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Danced, dancing. E. नृत to dance, क्त aff.
नर्त्तित: नर्त्तित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Danced, dancing. E. नृत to dance, क्त aff.
नर्द: नर्द्द r. 1st cl. (नर्द्दति प्रनर्द्दति) To sound: the radical न is not convertible to ण after a preposition, &c. see णर्द्द.
नर्द्द: नर्द्द r. 1st cl. (नर्द्दति प्रनर्द्दति) To sound: the radical न is not convertible to ण after a preposition, &c. see णर्द्द.
नर्दटक: नर्द्दटक n. (-कं) A kind of metre, containing eight feet of various syllabic quantities.
नर्द्दटक: नर्द्दटक n. (-कं) A kind of metre, containing eight feet of various syllabic quantities.
नर्दत्: नर्द्दत् mfn. (-र्द्दन्-र्द्दन्ती-र्द्दत्) 1 Sounding. 2 Praising aloud, proclaiming. E. नर्द्द, and शतृ aff.
नर्द्दत्: नर्द्दत् mfn. (-र्द्दन्-र्द्दन्ती-र्द्दत्) 1 Sounding. 2 Praising aloud, proclaiming. E. नर्द्द, and शतृ aff.
नर्दन: नर्द्दन n. (-नं) 1 Sounding, roaring, making a noise. 2 Celebrating, praising aloud. E. नर्द्द to sound, affix ल्युट.
नर्द्दन: नर्द्दन n. (-नं) 1 Sounding, roaring, making a noise. 2 Celebrating, praising aloud. E. नर्द्द to sound, affix ल्युट.
नर्दनीय: नर्द्दनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be sounded. 2 To be celebrated or praised aloud. E. नर्द्द sound, and अनीयर् aff.
नर्द्दनीय: नर्द्दनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be sounded. 2 To be celebrated or praised aloud. E. नर्द्द sound, and अनीयर् aff.
नर्दित: नर्द्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sounded, made as a noise. 2 Celebrated, praised aloud. n. (-तं) Sound, roar, bellowing. E. नर्द्द to sound, क्त aff.
नर्द्दित: नर्द्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sounded, made as a noise. 2 Celebrated, praised aloud. n. (-तं) Sound, roar, bellowing. E. नर्द्द to sound, क्त aff.
नर्द्धटक: नर्द्धटक m. (-कं) A stanza of four parts, having seventeen syllables in each.
नर्ब: नर्ब्ब r. 1st. cl. (नर्ब्बति) To go, to move.
नर्ब्ब: नर्ब्ब r. 1st. cl. (नर्ब्बति) To go, to move.
नर्मकील: नर्म्मकील m. (-लः) A husband. E. नर्म्म amusement, कील a prop or stay.
नर्म्मकील: नर्म्मकील m. (-लः) A husband. E. नर्म्म amusement, कील a prop or stay.
नर्मगर्भ: नर्म्मगर्भ m. (-र्भः) A secret lover. E. नर्म्म, and गर्भ source.
नर्म्मगर्भ: नर्म्मगर्भ m. (-र्भः) A secret lover. E. नर्म्म, and गर्भ source.
नर्मट: नर्म्मट m. (-टः) 1 The sun. 2 A potsherd. E. नर्म्म, and अट what goes, deriv. irr.
नर्म्मट: नर्म्मट m. (-टः) 1 The sun. 2 A potsherd. E. नर्म्म, and अट what goes, deriv. irr.
नर्मठ: नर्म्मठ m. (-ठः) 1 The nipple. 2 A rake, a lecher, a libertine. 3 Sport, amusement. 4 Coition. E. नर्म्म pleasure, स्था to abide, ड affix, deriv. irr.
नर्म्मठ: नर्म्मठ m. (-ठः) 1 The nipple. 2 A rake, a lecher, a libertine. 3 Sport, amusement. 4 Coition. E. नर्म्म pleasure, स्था to abide, ड affix, deriv. irr.
नर्मद: नर्म्मद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Delighting, making happy, giving pleasure. m. (-दः) The associate or companion of a person's sports or amusements. f. (-दा) 1 The Narmadā river, which rising in the Vindhyā mountains, runs westward to the gulf of Cambay. 2 A plant: see पृक्का. E. नर्म्म pleasure, and द what gives.
नर्म्मद: नर्म्मद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Delighting, making happy, giving pleasure. m. (-दः) The associate or companion of a person's sports or amusements. f. (-दा) 1 The Narmadā river, which rising in the Vindhyā mountains, runs westward to the gulf of Cambay. 2 A plant: see पृक्का. E. नर्म्म pleasure, and द what gives.
नर्मद्युति: नर्म्मद्युति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Happy, merry. f. (-तिः) Enjoyment of a joke or any amusement. E. नर्म्म, and द्युति lustre.
नर्म्मद्युति: नर्म्मद्युति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Happy, merry. f. (-तिः) Enjoyment of a joke or any amusement. E. नर्म्म, and द्युति lustre.
नर्मन्: नर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 1 Sport, amusement, pastime, diversion. 2 Jest, joke. 3 Wit, humour. E. नृ to guide, affix मनिन्.
नर्म्मन्: नर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 1 Sport, amusement, pastime, diversion. 2 Jest, joke. 3 Wit, humour. E. नृ to guide, affix मनिन्.
नर्मसचिव: नर्म्मसचिव m. (-वः) A companion, an associate, the promoter and partaker of a person's amusements, especially of a prince or man of rank. E. नर्म्मन्, and सचिव a minister.
नर्म्मसचिव: नर्म्मसचिव m. (-वः) A companion, an associate, the promoter and partaker of a person's amusements, especially of a prince or man of rank. E. नर्म्मन्, and सचिव a minister.
नर्मसाचिव्य: नर्म्मसाचिव्य n. (-व्यं) Superintendence or provision of a prince's amusements, partaking a person's amusements. E. नर्म्मसाचिव, and ष्यञ् aff.
नर्म्मसाचिव्य: नर्म्मसाचिव्य n. (-व्यं) Superintendence or provision of a prince's amusements, partaking a person's amusements. E. नर्म्मसाचिव, and ष्यञ् aff.
नर्मस्फूर्ज: नर्म्मस्फूर्ज्ज m. (-र्ज्जः) Happiness or amusement ending in alarm. E. नर्म्म, and स्फूर्ज्ज thundering.
नर्म्मस्फूर्ज्ज: नर्म्मस्फूर्ज्ज m. (-र्ज्जः) Happiness or amusement ending in alarm. E. नर्म्म, and स्फूर्ज्ज thundering.
नर्मस्फोट: नर्म्मस्फोट m. (-टः) Slight or inferior amusement. E. नर्म्म, and स्फोट opening.
नर्म्मस्फोट: नर्म्मस्फोट m. (-टः) Slight or inferior amusement. E. नर्म्म, and स्फोट opening.
नल: नल r. 10th cl. (नालयति) 1 To shine. 2 To bind or confine.

नल m. (-लः) 1 A reed, (Arundo karka, Rox.) 2 The name of a king, son of NIṢADHA, and hero of several poetical works famous amongst the Hindus, especially the poem called Naiṣadha. 3 Another prince, the son of VĪRASENA. 4 A deified progenitor or Pitṛdeva. 5 The name of a monkey chief. 6 A demon. f. (-ली) Red arsenick. 2 A perfume, commonly called by the same name of Nali. n. (-लं) 1 The water lily, (Nelumbium speciosum.) 2 Smell, odour. E. नल to shine, affix अच्.
नलक: नलक n. (-कं) A bone of either of the extremities, any long bone. E. नल a reed, and कन् affix of resemblance.
नलकिनी: नलकिनी f. (-नी) The knee cap or pan. E. नलक as above, and इनि affix; connecting the bones of the lower extremity.
नलकील: नलकील m. (-लः) The knee. E. नल a reed, or reed-like bone, and कील a pin or bolt.
नलकूवेर: नलकूवेर m. (-रः) The son of KUVERA. E. नल a reed, कूवेर a carriage yoke.
नलद: नलद n. (-दं) Indian spikenard, (Valeriana jatamansi.) f. (-दा) 1 The honey or nectar of a flower. 2 The root of the Andropogon muricatum. E. नल here said to mean, fragrance, and द what gives.
नलपट्टिका: नलपट्टिका f. (-का) A sort of mat made with reeds, a coarse mat. E. नल a reed, and पट्ट a cloth, कन् affix of similitude.
नलमीन: नलमीन m. (-नः) A kind of sprat, or according to some, a shrimp or prawn. E. नल a reed, and मीन a fish; frequenting reedy spots.
नलिका: नलिका f. (-का) A perfume: see नली. E. नली, and कन् added.
नलिन: नलिन n. (-नं) 1 A lotus or water lily, (Nelumbium speciosum, or Nymphaea nelumbo.) 2 Water. 3 Indigo. m. (-नः) 1 The Indian crane. 2 A small fruit, Karonda. f. (-नी) 1 An assemblage of lotus flowers. 2 A place abounding in lotuses. 3 The flexible stalk of a water lily. 4 A pond in which the lotus grows or may grow. 5 The Ganges of heaven. 6 The fermented and intoxicating juice of the cocoanut. E. नल to be bright, Uṇādi affix इनच्.
नलिनीरुह: नलिनीरुह m. (-हः) 1 BRAHMĀ. 2 The fibres of the lotus stalk. E. नलिनी, and रुह what grows.
नलिनेशय: नलिनेशय m. (-यः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. नलिने in a lotus, and शय who sleeps.
नल्व: नल्व m. (-ल्वः) A furlong, a distance measured by four hundred cubits. E. नल to be as a reed in length, and व aff.
नल्ववर्त्मगा: नल्ववर्त्मगा f. (-गा) The orange tree. E. नल्व as above, वर्त्म a road, and ग what goes.
नव: नव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) New. m. (-बः) Praise, panegyrick, celebration. E. नु to praise, &c. affix अच्.
नवकारिका: नवकारिका f. (-का) 1 A bride, a woman newly married. 2 A new comment. E. नव new, and कारिका agent.
नवकास्तिका: नवकास्तिका f. (-का) A young woman, either one recently married or one in whom menstruation has lately commenced. E. नव new, काल time, कन् added with the fem. form.
नवग्रह: नवग्रह m. plu. (-हाः) The nine planets, or sun, moon, five planets, and the ascending and descending nodes. E. नव for नवन्, and ग्रह a planet.
नवच्छात्र: नवछात्र m. (-त्रः) A student, a novice. E. नव new, and छात्र a disciple.
नवछात्र: नवछात्र m. (-त्रः) A student, a novice. E. नव new, and छात्र a disciple.
नवत: नवत m. (-तः) An elephant's painted or variegated housings. E. नव new, तन् to spread, affix ड.
नवता: नवता f. (-ता) Novelty. E. तल् added to नव; also with त्व, नवत्वं.
नवति: नवति f. (-तिः or -ती) Ninety. E. नव nine, and क्तिन् aff.
नवतिका: नवतिका f. (-का) A painting brush. E. नवति ninety, (hairs,) कन् aff.
नवतिधा: नवतिधा ind. Ninety-fold. E. नवति, and घा aff.
नवतिशस्: नवतिशस् ind. Ninety by ninety. E. नवति, and शस् aff.
नवदल: नवदल n. (-लं) 1 The new leaf of a lotus. 2 Any young leaf. E. नव new, and दल a leaf.
नवदीधिति: नवदीधिति m. (-तिः) Mars, the planet or its deified regent. E. नव nine, दीधिति a ray.
नवदुर्गा: नवदुर्गा f. (-र्गा) The nine forms of DURGĀ. E. नव, and दुर्गा the goddess.
नवदोला: नवदोला f. (-ला) A litter borne by nine men. E. नव, and दोल a litter.
नवद्वार: नवद्वार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Having nine doors; an epithet applied to the body, which has nine inlets or outlets, as the nostrils, ears, mouth, &c. E. नव, and द्वार a door.
नवधा: नवधा ind. Nine-fold, in nine ways. E. नव nine, and धा aff.
नवनीत: नवनीत n. (-तं) Fresh butter. E. नव new, and नीत procured (from milk, &c.)
नवनीतक: नवनीतक n. (-कं) Clarified butter. E. कन् added to the last.
नवनीतधेनु: नवनीतधेनु f. (-नुः) A quantity of butter as a present to Brahmans. E. नवनीत, and धेनु a milch cow.
नवपल्लव: नवपल्लव n. (-वं) A new shoot or sprout. E. नव, and पल्लव a shoot.
नवफलिका: नवफलिका f. (-का) 1 A bride, a newly married woman. 2 A girl in whom menstruation has recently begun. E. नव new, फल fruit, and ठक् aff.
नवबधू: नवबधू n. (-धूः) A bride, a newly married woman. E. नव, and बधु a wife.
नवम: नवम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Ninth. f. (-मी) The ninth day of a lunar half month. E. नव nine, and मट् aff.
नवमल्लिका: नवमल्लिका f. (-का) Double jasmine: see the next.
नवमालिका: नवमालिका f. (-का) Double jasmine, (J. Zambac.) E. नव excellent, praised, and मालिका or मलिका jasmine: see the last.
नवयौवना: नवयौवना f. (-ना) A young woman. E. नव new, and यौवन young.
नवरक्तक: नवरक्तक f. (-कं) A newly dyed garment. E. नव, रक्त red, and कन् aff.
नवरङ्ग: नवरङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) Gift to five and acceptance by four persons of the best Kāyastha families. E. नव, and रङ्ग colour.
नवरत्न: नवरत्न n. (त्नं) 1 Nine precious gems, or a pearl, ruby, topaz, diamond, emerald, lapis lazuli, coral, sapphire, and one called Gomeda. 2 The nine men of letters at the court of VIKRAMĀDITYA, or DHANVANTARI, KṢAPAṆAKA, AMARASIṂHA, SAṄKU, VETĀLABHAṬṬA, GHAṬAKARPARA, KĀLIDĀSA, VARĀHAMIHIRA, and VARARUCI. E. नव, and रत्न a jewel.
नवरात्र: नवरात्र n. (-त्रं) The period of nine days, from the first of the light half of Aśvin to the ninth; part of the time devoted to the worship of DURGĀ. E. नव, and रात्र for रात्रि a night.
नववरिका: नववरिका f. (-का) A newly married woman. E. नव new, वर a blessing, affix कन् added, fem. affix टाप्.
नववस्त्र: नववस्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) New cloth. E. नव new, and वस्त्र cloth.
नवशस्: नवशस् ind. Nine by nine. E. नव, and शस् aff.
नवशस्य: नवशस्य n. (-स्यं) Grain of the year's harvest. E. नव, and शस्य grain.
नवशस्येष्टि: नवशस्येष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A sacrifice performed on eating the new rice or grain of the year. E. नवशस्य, and इष्टि sacrifice.
नवशायक: नवशायक m. (-कः) A name given to any of nine inferior classes, the cowherd, gardener, oilman, weaver, confectioner, water-carrier, potter, blacksmith, and barber.
नवश्राद्ध: नवश्राद्ध n. (-द्धं) The first series of Śrāddhas collectively, or funeral offerings on the first, third, fifth, seventh, ninth, and eleventh days after a person's demise. E. नव, and श्राद्ध obsequial rite.
नवसूतिका: नवसूतिका f. (-का) 1 A milch cow. 2 A woman recently delivered. E. नक new, and सूत offspring, and कन् affix, fem. form.
नवांश: नवांश m. (-शः) A ninth, a ninth part. E. नव, and अंश share.
नवान्न: नवान्न n. (-न्नं) 1 New rice or grain. 2 A ceremony observed on first eating the rice, &c. of the last harvest. E. नव, and अन्न food.
नवाम्बर: नवाम्बर n. (-रं) New and unbleached cloth. E. नव new, and अम्बर cloth.
नवार्चिस्: नवार्च्चिस् m. (-र्च्चिः) The planet Mars or its deified personification. E. नव nine, and अर्च्चिस् light.
नवार्च्चिस्: नवार्च्चिस् m. (-र्च्चिः) The planet Mars or its deified personification. E. नव nine, and अर्च्चिस् light.
नवाह: नवाह m. (-हः) 1 A new day. 2 The first day of the fortnight. E. नव new, and अह a day.
नवीकरण: नवीकरण n. (-णं) Renewing, doing or making anew. E. नव, करण making, च्चि augment.
नवीकृत: नवीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Renewed, revived, done or made anew. E. नव, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
नवीन: नवीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) New. E. नव new, ख pleonasm, and the semivowel changed.
नवीभूत: नवीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Renewed, revived. E. नव, and भूत become, च्चि augment.
नवै: नवै ind. Not so perhaps, a particle implying doubt. E. न not, वै expletive.
नवोढा: नवोढा f. (-ढा) A newly married woman, a bride. E. नव new, and ऊढा a wife.
नवोद्धृत: नवोद्धृत n. (-तं) Fresh butter. E. नव new, उद्धृत made.
नव्य: नव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) New, recent, young, &c. m. (-व्यः) Praise, panegyrick. E. नव new, and यत् aff.
नशाक: नशाक m. (-कः) A bird, said to be a sort of crow. E. णश to destroy, affix आक.
नशितृ: नशितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Destroying. E. णश to destroy, affix तृच् with इट् augment, else with a nasal augment नष्टृ.
नश्यत्: नश्यत् mfn. (-श्यन्-श्यन्ती-श्यत्) Perishing, decaying, wasting, being destroyed. E. नश to perish, and शतृ aff.
नश्यत्प्रसूतिका: नश्यत्प्रसूतिका f. (-का) A female bearing a dead child. E. नश्यत्, प्रसूतिका a mother.
नश्वर: नश्वर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Mischievous, destructive. E. णशि to destroy, affix क्वरप्.
नष्ट: नष्ट mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Lost, destroyed, removed, annihilated. E. णश to perish, affix क्त.
नष्टचन्द्र: नष्टचन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) The moon on the fourth lunation of either half of Bhādra. E. नष्ट, and चन्द्र the moon: it is very unlucky to see the moon on these days.
नष्टचेतन: नष्टचेतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fainted, insensible. E. नष्ट, and चेतन conscious.
नष्टचेष्ट: नष्टचेष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Insensible, inert. E. नष्ट, and चेष्टा effort.
नष्टचेष्टता: नष्टचेष्टता f. (-ता) Fainting, swooning, insensibility, proceeding either from joy or sorrow, &c. E. नष्ट lost, चेष्टता effort.
नष्टसंस्मृति: नष्टसंस्मृति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Unmindful, forgetful. E. नष्ट, and संस्मृति recollection.
नष्टाग्नि: नष्टाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) A Brahman or householder who has lost his consecrated fire. E. नष्ट lost, and अग्नि fire.
नष्टाप्तिसूत्र: नष्टाप्तिसूत्र n. (-त्रं) Booty, plunder. E. नष्ट lost, आप्ति gain, and सूत्र thread or chain.
नष्टार्थ: नष्टार्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) Reduced, become poor. E. नष्ट, and अर्थ wealth.
नष्टेन्दुकला: नष्टेन्दुकला f. (-ला) The day of new moon when it rises invisible. E. नष्ट, and इन्दुकला a digit.
नस्: नस् f. (-नाः) The nose. E. नस to sound, affix क्विप्.
नसा: नसा f. (-सा) The nose: see नासा and नासिका.
नस्त: नस्त m. (-स्तः) The nose. n. (-स्तं) A sternutatory, snuff, &c. f. (-स्ता) A hole bored in the septum of the nose. E. णस to make crooked, affix क्त.
नस्तित: नस्तित m. (-तः) An ox or any other draft animal, with a string through his nose, the sort of rein usually employed in India. E. नस्त as above, the nose, formed into a nominal verb, and क्त added, nozzled or nose-led.
नस्तोत: नस्तोत m. (-तः) An ox led by a string through his nose: see the last; also नस्योत.
नस्य: नस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Nasal, relating or belonging to the nose. n. (-स्यं) A sternutatory, snuff. f. (-स्या) The nose. E. नसा the nose, यत् aff.
नस्योत: नस्योत m. (-तः) An ox or other animal led by a string through the septum of the nose. E. नसा the nose, यत् affix of relation or fitness, and ऊत woven: see नस्तित.
नह: नह (औ) औनह r. 4th cl. (नह्यति-ते) To bind: see णह.
नहि: नहि ind. No, not. E. णह to bind or tie, affix इन्.
नहुष: नहुष m. (-षः) 1 The name of a Nāga or serpent. 2 The name of a king, one of the lunar race, son of ĀYUS and grandson of PURŪRAVAS. E. णह to bind, Uṇādi affix उषन.
नहुषात्मज: नहुषात्मज m. (-जः) A king, also YAYĀTI. E. नहुष as above, आत्मज son.
नाक: नाक m. (-कः) Heaven, paradise, æther, sky, atmosphere. E. न not, with अक derived from क happiness, and the privative अ prefixed, misery; in which there is no unhappiness.
नाकनाथ: नाकनाथ m. (-थः) A name of INDRA. E. नाक paradise, and नाथ lord; also with कन् added नाकनाथक.
नाकनायक: नाकनायक m. (-कः) INDRA. E. नाक, and नायक a chief.
नाकवनिता: नाकवनिता f. (-ता) A nymph of heaven. E. नाक, and वनिता a wife.
नाकसद्: नाकसद् m. (-सत्) A deity. E. नाक, and सद् who dwells in.
नाकिन्: नाकिन् m. (-की) A deity, a god. E. नाक heaven, and इनि aff.
नाकु: नाकु m. (-कुः) 1 An ant or mole hill, a burrow. 2 A mountain. 3 A name of a Muni or saint. E. न privative, अक to go, affix उ, or नम to be crooked or bowed, Uṇādi affix उ, and नाक substituted for the radical letters.
नाकुल: नाकुल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Relating or belonging to an ichneumon. f. (-ली) 1 A plant: the ichneumon plant, a vegetable supposed to furnish the mungoose with an antidote, when bitten in a conflict with a snake, (Serpent ophioxylon?) 2 The root of the Simul tree, (कुक्कुटीकन्द.) A sort of pepper, (Piper chavya.) E. नकुल the ichneumon, affixes अण् and ङीष्.
नाकुलान्ध्य: नाकुलान्ध्य n. (-न्ध्यं) Weakness of sight. E. नाकुल, and अन्ध्य blindness.
नाकुसद्मन्: नाकुसद्मन् m. (-द्मा) A snake. E. नाकु a mound of earth, सद्मन् a dwelling.
नाक्षत्र: नाक्षत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं) Relating or belonging to the lunar asterisms. n. (-त्रं) A month, one computed by the moon's passage through the twenty-seven mansions, or of thirty days of sixty Gharis each. E. नक्षत्र, and अण् aff.
नाक्षत्रिक: नाक्षत्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or belonging to the lunar asterisms. m. (-कः) A month of twenty-seven days, each day being the period of the moon's passage through a lunar asterism. f. (-की) The state or condition to which a person is subjected agreeably to the asterism presiding over his nativity. E. नक्षत्र as above, and ठक् aff.
नाग: नाग m. (-गः) 1 A Nāga or demigod so called, having a human face, with the tail of a serpent, and the expanded neck of the Koluber Nāga; the race of these beings is said to have sprung from KADRU, the wife of KAŚYAPA, in order to people Pātāla or the regions below the earth. 2 A serpent in general, or especially the spectacle snake, or cobra capella, (Coluber Naga.) 3 An elephant. 4 A cruel or tyrannical person. 5 A cloud. 6 (In composition,) Pre-eminent. 7 A pin or nail projecting from a wall to hang any thing upon. 8 A small tree, (Mesua ferrea.) 9 A sort of grass, (Cyperus pertenuis.) 10 A tree used in dying, (Rottleria tinctoria.) 11 One of the airs of the body, that which is expelled by belching. 12 Betle or Pān. 13 The name of a country. n. (-गं) 1 Tin. 2 Lead. 3 One of the astronomical periods called Karaṇas; it is one of those termed invariable, and always corresponds to the last half of Amāvāsyā or new moon. 4 The effects of that period on any thing done or happening during it. E. नग a mountain, and अण् affix; living or produced in mountainous regions, &c.
नागकेशर: नागकेशर m. (-रः) A small tree, commonly Nagesara, (Mesua ferrea). E. नाग, and केशर synonyms of the same plant compounded; the word is also written नागकेसर.
नागगर्भ: नागगर्भ n. (-र्भं) Red lead. E. नाग lead, and गर्भ origin.
नागज: नागज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced by or of a Nāga, &c. n. (-जं) 1 Red lead. 2 Tin. E. नाग lead, &c. and ज produced.
नागजिह्वा: नागजिह्वा f. (-ह्वा) A plant, (Asclepias pseudosarsa:) see शारिवा. E. नाग a snake, and जिह्वा a tongue.
नागजिह्विका: नागजिह्विका f. (-का) Red arsenick. E. नाग a snake, जिह्वा a tongue, कन् affix of comparison.
नागजीवन: नागजीवन m. (-नः) Tin. E. नाग lead, जीवन proceeding.
नागदन्त: नागदन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 Elephant's tooth or ivory; also the tooth of the elephant. 2 A shelf, a pin or bracket projecting from a wall, and used to hang things upon. f. (-न्ती) 1 A sort of sun-flower, (Heliotropium Indicum.) 2 A whore. E. नाग an elephant, and दन्त a tooth.
नागदन्तक: नागदन्तक m. (-कः) A wooden pin or bracket, projecting from a wall, a shelf. E. नागदन्त an elephant's tooth, and कन् affix of resemblance.
नागदन्तिका: नागदन्तिका f. (-का) A plant, commonly called Rāmadūtī: see विशल्या. E. नागदन्ती a plant, and कन् affix of resemblance.
नागदलोपम: नागदलोपम m. (-मः) A sort of tree, commonly Parusha. E. नाग one of the plants so called, दल a leaf, and उपमा resemblance.
नागद्रु: नागद्रु m. (-द्रुः) Euphorbia. E. नाग a snake, and द्रु a tree; being used in offerings to the snake goddess MANASĀ.
नागनिर्यूह: नागनिर्य्यूह m. (-हः) A large pin or bracket, projecting from a wall like a shelf. E. नाग an elephant, and निर्य्यूह projection.
नागनिर्य्यूह: नागनिर्य्यूह m. (-हः) A large pin or bracket, projecting from a wall like a shelf. E. नाग an elephant, and निर्य्यूह projection.
नागपाश: नागपाश m. (-शः) 1 A weapon of VARUṆA, the regent of water. 2 A sort of noose or knot, used in battle to entangle an enemy. E. नाग an elephant, and पाश a binding.
नागपुष्प: नागपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) 1 A tree used in dyeing, (Rottleria tinctoria.) 2 Nagesara, (Mesua ferrea.) 3 The Champaka, (Michelia champaca.) E. नाग an elephant, and पुष्प flower.
नागबन्धु: नागबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.) E. नाग an elephant, and बन्धु friendly, liked.
नागबल: नागबल m. (-लः) A name of BHĪMA. f. (-ला) A creeping plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.) E. नाग an elephant, and बल strong.
नागभिद्: नागभिद् m. (-भिद्) A sort of snake, (Amphisbæna.) E. नाग an elephant, and भिद् destroying; the word is sometimes written नागभृत्, from भृत् cherishing.
नागमल्ल: नागमल्ल m. (-ल्लः) The elephant of INDRA. E. नाग elephant, and मल्ल a boxer.
नागमातृ: नागमातृ f. (-ता) 1 A name of MANASĀ, a goddess supposed to preside over snakes. 2 Red arsenick. E. नाग a snake, and मातृ a mother.
नागमार: नागमार m. (-रः) A sort of potherb; also केशराज. E. नाग a snake, and मार destroying; considered as an antidote.
नागयष्टि: नागयष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A piece of wood erected in a place dug for water. E. नाग a snake, and यष्टि a staff; looking like a snake; also नागयष्टिका.
नागर: नागर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Clever, sharp, knowing, (as a buck, a blood, a wag, &c.) 2 Town-born or bred, city, citizen. 3 Nameless. 4 Bad, vile. n. (-रं) 1 Dry ginger. 2 A sort of grass, (Cyperus pertenuis.) 3 A form of writing, the Devanāgarī alphabet. m. (-रः) 1 A husband's brother. 9 An orange. 2 A lecturer. 4 Denial of knowledge. 5 Fatigue. 6 Desire of final beatitude. f. (-री) 1 A sort of Euphorbin. 2 A clever or intriguing woman. E. नगर a city, अण् aff.
नागरक: नागरक m. (-कः) 1 The orange: see नागरङ्ग. 2 A thief. 3 An artist. E. नगर, and वुञ् aff.
नागरक्त: नागरक्त m. (-क्तः) Red lead. E. नाग mountain, and रक्त red.
नागरङ्ग: नागरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The orange; in India usually applied to the Silhet orange, (Citrus aurantium). E. नाग an elephant, रञ्ज to be sick, affix घञ्; on which elephants feed till they become ill; or नाग red lead, and रङ्ग colour, of the colour of red lead.
नागराज: नागराज m. (-जः) ANANTA, the chief of the Nāgas. E. नाग, and राज king.
नागरीट: नागरीट m. (-टः) A libertine, a debauchee, a rake, a blackguard. E. नागरी an intriguing woman, अट to accompany, affix अच्, deriv. irr.
नागरुक: नागरुक m. (-कः) The orange: see नागरङ्ग.
नागरेणु: नागरेणु m. (-णुः) Red lead. E. नाग, and रेणु oxid.
नागरेयक: नागरेयक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) City, citizen. E. नगर a town, and ढकञ् aff.
नागलता: नागलता f. (-ता) The penis. E. नाग a snake, and लता a creeper.
नागलोक: नागलोक m. (-कः) The Nāga regions below the earth. E. नाग a Nāga, and लोक world.
नागवल्लिका: नागवल्लिका f. (-का) The betel plant: see the next.
नागवल्ली: नागवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) The betel plant, (Piper betel.) E. नाग the infernal Nāga, and वल्ली a creeper; the creeper of the lower regions; also with कन् added नागवल्लिका.
नागवारिक: नागवारिक m. (-कः) Garuḍa, the bird of VIṢṆU. 2 A peacock. 3 A royal elephant. 4 An elephant driver or keeper. 5 The chief person in a court or assembly. E. नाग an elephant, वृ to cherish, &c. affix ठक्.
नागवीट: नागवीट m. (-टः) A rake: see नागरीट.
नागवीथी: नागवीथी f. (-थी) The path of Airāvata, the milky way. E. नाग the elephant, वीथी a road or path.
नागसम्भव: नागसम्भव n. (-वं) Minium or red lead. E. नाग lead, and सम्भव production.
नागसुगन्धा: नागसुगन्धा f. (-न्धा) The ichneumon plant: see नाकुली. E. नाग a snake, and सुगन्ध perfume.
नागाख्य: नागाख्य m. (-ख्यः) A plant: see नागकेसर. E. नाग an elephant, and आख्या a name.
नागाञ्चला: नागाञ्चला f. (-ला) A stick or pole driven into a square piece of earth in the centre of a newly dug pond, a boring rod. E. नाग a snake, and अञ्चला end of a garment; it is also written नागाञ्जना f. (-ना) see नागयष्टि.
नागाधिप: नागाधिप m. (-पः) The great serpent ANANTA. E. नाग a serpent, and अधिप a king.
नागान्तक: नागान्तक m. (-कः) Garuḍa, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU. E. नाग a snake, and अन्तक a destroyer; this and similar compounds are also applied to the Ardea Argala, the peacock, and other birds who are natural enemies of the serpent genus.
नागारूढ: नागारूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) Mounted or riding upon an elephant. E. नाग, and आरूढ mounted.
नागाशन: नागाशन m. (-नः) Garuḍa: see नागान्तक. E. नाग a snake, and अशन food.
नागाह्व: नागाह्व n. (-ह्वं) Hastināpura or ancient Delhi. E. नाग an elephant, and आह्वा a name.
नागोद: नागोद n. (-दं) Armour for the front or the belly.
नागोदर: नागोदर n. (-रं) A breast-plate, a cuirass.
नाचिकेतु: नाचिकेतु m. (-तुः) A name of fire.
नाट: नाट n. (-टं) 1 Dancing, acting. 2 The Carnatic. E. नट to dance, affix घञ्.
नाटक: नाटक m. (-कः-की-कं) An actor, acting, dancing, &c. m. (-कः) A play, a drama: the first of the ten species of dramatic compositions of the first order. f. (-की) The court of INDRA. E. नट to act or perform, ण्वुल् aff.
नाटकप्रपञ्च: नाटकप्रपञ्च m. (-ञ्चः) Course or arrangement of a drama. E. नाटक and प्रपञ्च extent.
नाटकीय: नाटकीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Dramatic. E. नाटक, and छ aff.
नाटाम्र: नाटाम्र m. (-म्रः) The water melon, (Cucurbita citrullus.)
नाटार: नाटार m. (-रः) The son of an actress.
नाटिका: नाटिका f. (-का) A short or light comedy, the first of the Uparūpakas or dramas of the second order. E. नट to dance, ण्वुल् aff.
नाटेय: नाटेय m. (-यः) The son of an actress. E. नटी, and ढक् aff.
नाटेर: नाटेर m. (-रः) The son of an actress or dancing girl. E. नटी, an actress, द्रक् aff.
नाट्य: नाट्य n. (-ट्यं) The science or art of dancing or acting, or the union of song, dance, and instrumental musick. E. नट to dance, affix ण्यत् or ज्य.
नाट्यधर्म्मिक: नाट्यधर्म्मिक m. (-कः) Rules of dramatic representation. E. नाट्य acting, धर्म्म rule, and ठक् aff.
नाट्यप्रिय: नाट्यप्रिय m. (-यः) A name of ŚIVA. E. नाट्य dancing, and प्रिय fond of.
नाट्यशाला: नाट्यशाला f. (-ला) A theatre, a building for dramatic exhibitions; according to some it should be built near the gate of a palace. E. नाट्य, and शाला a hall.
नाट्योक्ति: नाट्योक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Dramatic phraseology. E. नाट्य, and उक्ति expression.
नाडि: नाडि f. (-डिः-डी) 1 The stalk or culm of any plant. 2 Any tubular organ of the body, as an artery, a vein, an intestine, &c. 3 The hollow stalk of a lotus, &c. 4 A fistulous sore, a fistula, a sinus. 5 A sort of bent grass. 6 A juggling trick. 7 Deception. 8 An hour of twenty-four minutes. 9 Any pipe or tube. 10 The pulse, either at the hand or feet, &c. E. नड to fall off or from, affix अच्, and इ or ङीष्, optionally added.
नाडिका: नाडिका f. (-का) An Indian hour, or twenty-four minutes. E. नाडि the same, कन् pleonasm.
नाडिकेल: नाडिकेल m. (-लः) The cocoanut: see नारिकेल.
नाडिचीर: नाडिचीर n. (-रं) A small reed or tube round which the woof is wound; it is then used as a shuttle. E. नाडि a tube, and चीर old cloth.
नाडिन्धम: नाडिन्धम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Terrifying. 2 Moving the intestines. m. (-मः) A goldsmith. E. नाडि a tube, a hollow bambu, &c. and धम who blows, from ध्मा, with खश् aff.
नाडिन्धय: नाडिन्धय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Who or what drinks or sucks through a tube. E. नाडि a pipe, धे to drink, affix खश्.
नाडिपत्र: नाडिपत्र m. (-त्रं) An esculent root, (Arum colocasia.) E. नाडि a tube, पत्र a leaf.
नाडिमण्डल: नाडिमण्डल n. (-लं) The celestial equator. E. नाडि, and मण्डल a sphere.
नाडीकेल: नाडीकेल m. (-लः) The cocoanut: see नाडिकेल.
नाडीच: नाडीच n. (-त्रं) An esculent root, (Arum colocasia.) E. नाडी a tube, चर to go or grow, affix ड.
नाडीचरण: नाडीचरण m. (-णः) A bird in general. E. नाडी a tube, चरण a foot.
नाडीजङ्घ: नाडीजङ्घ m. (-ङ्घः) 1 A crow. 2 The name of a holy teacher or saint. 3 The name of a fabulous crane. E. नाडी a stalk, and जङ्घा a leg or thigh.
नाडीतरङ्ग: नाडीतरङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A sort of poison: see काकोल. 2 An astrologer. 3 A ravisher, a debaucher. E. नाडी an Indian hour, and तरङ्ग a wave; also नाडीतरङ्गक.
नाडीदेह: नाडीदेह m. (-हः) BHṚṄGI, one of ŚIVA'S followers. E. नाडी a tube, and देह the body; as thin.
नाडीनक्षत्र: नाडीनक्षत्र n. (-त्रं) The planet of a person's nativity. E. नाडी, and नक्षत्र an asterism.
नाडीविग्रह: नाडीविग्रह m. (-हः) A name of BHṚṄGI, one of ŚIVA'S chief attendants. E. नाडी a pipe, and विग्रह the body; also नाडीदेह, &c.
नाडीव्रण: नाडीव्रण m. (-णः) An ulcer. E. नाडी a sinus, and व्रण a sore.
नाडीस्नेह: नाडीस्नेह m. (-हः) A name of BHṚṄGI: see नाडीदेह.
नाणक: नाणक n. (-कं) A coin, or any thing struck or stamped with an impression.
नाणकपरीक्षा: नाणकपरीक्षा f. (-क्षा) Assaying. E. नाणक, and परीक्षा trial.
नाणकपरीक्षिन्: नाणकपरीक्षिन् m. (-क्षी) An assayer. E. नाणक, and परीक्षिन् who tries.
नात्र: नात्र n. (-त्रं) 1 Praise, eulogium. 2 Surprise, wonder. m. (-त्रः) ŚIVA. 2 A sage. E. नम to bow, ष्ट्रण् affix, म is dropped, and the short radical vowel made long.
नाथ: नाथ (ऋ) नाथृ r. 1st cl. (नाथति-ते) 1 To ask or beg. 2 To bless. 3 To destroy. 4 To have wealth or power. 5 To be deceased.

नाथ m. (-थः) 1 A master, a lord. 2 A name of ŚIVA, especially in the form of a Liṅga; it is usually compounded with some word relating to the legendary history of the Liṅga, as Somanātha, the Liṅga a set up by SOMA, &c. 3 A name adopted by a class of Yogis, as GORAKHNĀTH, &c. 4 A rope passed through the nose of a draft ox. E. नाथ to ask, (from whom,) and अच् aff.
नाथवत्: नाथवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Dependant, subservient, subject. E. नाथ master, and मतुप् poss. aff.
नाथहरि: नाथहरि m. (-रिः) An animal bridled by the nose. E. नाथ the string, हृ to take, इन् aff.
नाथहार: नाथहार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Taking or carrying a master, &c. E. नाथ, हृ to take, अण् aff.
नाद: नाद m. (-दः) 1 Sound in general. 2 A semicircle, used especially as an abbreviation or hieroglyphic in mystical works. E. नद to sound, affix घञ्.
नादिन्: नादिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Who or what sounds. E. नद to sound, घिणुन् aff.
नादेय: नादेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Ocean or river-born, marine, aquatick. n. (-यं) 1 Sea salt. 2 Antimony. f. (-यी) 1 A sort of reed growing usually near water, (Calamus fasciculatus, Rox.) 2 A plant, (Premna herbacea, Rox.) 3 The orange. 4 A tree: see जयन्ती. 5 The China rose. E. नद a river or the sea, and ढक् affix, fem. affix ङीप्; also with कन् added, in the fem. form नादेयिका f. (-का)
नाध: नाध (ऋ) नाधृ r. 1st cl. (नाधते) 1 To ask or beg. 2 To bless. 3 To destroy. 4 To have wealth or power. 5 To be deceased.
नाना: नाना ind. 1 Without, except. 2 Many, various. 3 Double or twofold. E. नञ् negative, and नाञ् aff.
नानाध्वनि: नानाध्वनि m. (-निः) A musical instrument of more than one tone. E. नाना various, and ध्वनि sound.
नानारस: नानारस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Of different flavours. E. नाना, and रस flavour.
नानाराग: नानाराग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Variegated, of many colours. E. नाना, and राग colour.
नानारूप: नानारूप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) Multiform, various. E. नाना various, and रूप form.
नानावर्ण: नानावर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Variegated, many-coloured. E. नाना, and वर्ण colour.
नानाविध: नानाविध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) 1 In various ways. 2 Of various sorts or kinds. E. नाना, and विध kind.
नानुष्ठेय: नानुष्ठेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Improper, unusual, not right or customary. E. न not, अनु according to, ष्ठेय from स्था to be, to be fixed or determined.
नान्दिकर: नान्दिकर m. (-रः) The speaker of the prologue to a drama: see नान्दीकर.
नान्दी: नान्दी f. (-न्दी) 1 Eulogium of a king, or praise of a deity, recited in benedictory verses at the commencement of a religious ceremony, or the opening of a drama; it most usually signifies the kind of blessing pronounced as a prologue to a Nāṭaka or play. 2 Prosperity, thriving, increase. E. नदि to be happy, in the causal form, affix इन्, and ङीष्; delighting the gods, &c. or procuring happiness for mankind.
नान्दीक: नान्दीक m. (-कः) A post in a door-way, set up for good luck. E. नान्दी prosperity, कृ to make, affix ड.
नान्दीकर: नान्दीकर m. (-रः) The speaker of the prologue or prelude of a drama. E. नान्दी as above, कर who makes; also with the vowel made short, नान्दिकर.
नान्दीपट: नान्दीपट m. (-टः) The lid or cover of a well.
नान्दीमुख: नान्दीमुख m. (-खः) 1 The lid or cover of a well. 2 The class of male progenitors to whom the Nāndī-mukha Śrāddha is addressed. f. (-खी) A female ancestor sharing in the same. n. (-खं) 1 A species of the Śarkarī metre. 2 A Śrāddha or funeral obsequies performed on joyous occasions, as initiation, marriage, &c. in which nine balls of meat are offered to the deceased father, paternal grandfather, and great grandfather; to the maternal grandfather, great grandfather, and great great grandfather; and to the mother, paternal grandmother, and paternal great grandmother. E. नान्दी good fortune, मुख principal.
नान्दीवादिन्: नान्दीवादिन् m. (-दी) 1 The speaker of the prologue or introduction to a drama. 2 A drummer, one who beats a drum at festivals, &c. E. नान्दी as above, and वादिन् who speaks.
नापि: नापि ind. Not even. E. न not, and अपि even.
नापित: नापित m. (-तः) A barber. E. न negative, आप to obtain, (respect,) तन् Uṇādi affix, and इट् augment.
नापितशाला: नापितशाला f. (-ला) A barber's shop. E. नापित, and शाला house; also with कन added in the fem. form, नापितशालिका f. (-का).
नापित्य: नापित्य m. (-त्यः) The business of a barber. E. नापित, and यत् aff.
नाभि: नाभि f. (-भिः-भी) 1 The nave of a wheel. 2 Musk. mf. (-भिः and भिः or भी) The navel. m. (-भिः) 1 An emperor, a sovereign, a lord paramount. 2 A king, a chief. 3 A Kṣatriya or Hindū of the regal and military tribe. 4 The son of PRIYAVRATA. 5 A race, a family. E. नह to bind, Uṇādi affix इञि, and भ substituted for ह.
नाभिकण्टक: नाभिकण्टक m. (-कः) Ruptured or protruded navel. E. नाभि a navel, and कण्टक a thorn.
नाभिगुडक: नाभिगुडक m. (-कः) A prominent or ruptured navel. E. नाभि, and गुडक a ball or lump.
नाभिगोलक: नाभिगोलक m. (-कः) A prominent or ruptured navel. E. नाभि, and गोलक a lump or ball.
नाभिच्छेदन: नाभिछेदन n. (-नं) Division of the umbilical cord. E. नाभि, and छेदन cutting.
नाभिछेदन: नाभिछेदन n. (-नं) Division of the umbilical cord. E. नाभि, and छेदन cutting.
नाभिज: नाभिज m. (-जः) BRAHMĀ. E. नाभि navel, and ज born; BRAHMĀ appearing from the lotus which sprung from the navel of VIṢṆU.
नाभिजन्मन्: नाभिजन्मन् m. (-न्मा) BRAHMĀ. E. नाभि the navel, and जन्मन birth: see the last.
नाभिनाडी: नाभिनाडी f. (-डी) The umbilical cord. E. नाभि, and नाडी a vessel.
नाभिनाला: नाभिनाला f. (-ला) The umbilical cord. E. नाभि the navel, and नाला a string, a vessel.
नाभिभू: नाभिभू m. (-भूः) BRAHMĀ. E. नाभि, and भू born: see नाभिज.
नाभिवर्द्धन: नाभिवर्द्धन n. (-नं) 1 Division of the umbilical cord. 2 Umbilical hernia. 3 Corpulency. E. नाभि, and वर्द्धन increasing.
नाभील: नाभील n. (-लं) 1 The groin of a woman. 2 A prominent or ruptured navel. 3 Pain. 4 The hollow of the navel. E. नाभि the navel, लच् aff.
नाभ्य: नाभ्य mfn. (-भ्यः-भ्या-भ्यं) Umbilical, of or relating to the navel. E. नाभि the navel, and यत aff.
नाभ्यावर्त: नाभ्यावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) The hollow or pit of the navel. E. नाभि a navel, आवर्त्त a round.
नाभ्यावर्त्त: नाभ्यावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) The hollow or pit of the navel. E. नाभि a navel, आवर्त्त a round.
नाम: नाम ind. A particle implying. 1 Certainty. 2 Possibility. 3 Anger. 4 Reproach. 5 Consent, promise. 6 Recollection. 7 Surprise. 8 Pretence, &c. as हिमालयो नाम नगाधिपः Himālaya, evidently the king of mountains, इह नाम सीता भविष्यति SĪTĀ will perhaps be here, &c. E. णम to call or address, affix ड, deriv. irr.
नामकरण: नामकरण n. (-णं) Naming a child first after birth. E. नाम, and करण making.
नामग्रह: नामग्रह n. (-हं) Addressing by name. E. नाम, and ग्रह taking; also नामग्रहण.
नामद्वादशी: नामद्वादशी f. (-शी) A religious ceremony, worshipping DURGĀ daily under one of twelve appellations. E. नाम, and द्वादशी twelfth.
नामधेय: नामधेय n. (-यं) A name or appellation. E. नाम a name, and धेय aff.
नामन्: नामन् n. (-म) A name, an appellation. E. म्ना to be minded or remembered, मनिन् Uṇādi affix, deriv. irr.
नामशेष: नामशेष m. (-षः-षा-षं) Dead, deceased. m. (-षः) Dying, death. E. नाम a name, and शेष end.
नामापराध: नामापराध m. (-धः) Abusing a respectable object, as a pious man, a deity by name. E. नाम, and अपराध offence.
नामित: नामित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bent, bent down, bowed. E. णम to bow, causal form, क्त aff.
नाय: नाय m. (-यः) 1 Guiding, directing, (morally or physically.) 2 Policy. 3 Obtaining. 4 Means, expedient. E. णी to guide, &c. affix ण or घञ्; also with अच् affix नय.
नायक: नायक m. (-कः) 1 A guide, a leader, a conductor. 2 A chief, a head, pre-eminent, principal. 3 A general, a commander. 4 The central gem of a necklace. 5 (In Erotick poetry,) The man, the husband or lover. f. (-यिका) 1 A mistress, a wife, the female in the amatory poetry of the Hindūs. 2 A sort of goddess, an inferior form of DURGĀ, and attendant upon her: there are eight Nāyikās. E. णी to guide, ण्वुल् aff.
नायकाधिप: नायकाधिप m. (-पः) A king, a sovereign prince. E. नायक a chief, and अधिप lord.
नार: नार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Relating to men, human, mortal, &c. 2 Spiritual. nf. (-रं-रा) Water. m. (-रः) A calf. n. (-रं) A multitude of men. E. नर, and अण् affix or न negative, ऋ to go, अप् aff.
नारक: नारक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Infernal, hellish. m. (-कः) Hell or the infernal regions. E. नरक hell, अण् aff.
नारकिन्: नारकिन् mfn. (-की-किनी-कि) Infernal, being in hell, condemned to or deserving it. E. नारक, and इनि aff.
नारकीट: नारकीट m. (-टः) 1 A sort of worm. 2 A deceiver, one who disappoints expectations excited by himself.
नारङ्ग: नारङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 The juice of the pepper plant. 2 An animal, one of twins. 3 A catamite. 4 The orange tree. E. नार many men, and ग who goes.
नारद: नारद m. (-दः) A name of NĀRADA, the son of BRAHMĀ, and one of the ten divine Munis or Ṛṣis; he is a friend of KṚṢṆA, a celebrated legislator, and inventor of the Vīṇā or lute. E. नार men, and दा to give, (instruction,) ड affix; or नार water, and द who gives; offering sacrifices to the manes.
नाराच: नाराच m. (-त्रः) 1 An iron arrow. (E. नार men, आङ् before चम to eat or consume, affix ड; destroying hosts of men.) 2 A bad or cloudy day. 3 A species of the Dhṛti metre. (E. नार water, आचम to spit, affix ड.) f. (-त्री) A goldsmith's scales, a fine or assay balance. E. नाराच an iron arrow, and ङीष् diminutive affix; also with कन् added in the fem. form, नाराचिका f. (-का)
नारायण: नारायण m. (-णः) 1 A name of VIṢṆU, but especially considered as the deity who was before all worlds. 2 A sage, the son of DHARMA, a manifestation of VIṢṆU. 3 A valiant combatant. f. (-णी) 1 A name of DURGĀ. 2 A name of LAKṢMĪ, the goddess of prosperity, and wife of VIṢṆU. 3 GAṄGĀ. 4 A plant, (Asparagus racemosa.) E. नारा the primeval waters, derived from नर the spirit of God, whence they originated, and अयन place of coming or moving; he who moved over the waters before creation: the word has several etymologies, as नर the spirit or soul of the universe, अण् affix, नार appertaining to it, the actions or emotions of the soul, and अयन pervading, influencing; again नार multitudes, mankind, and अयन place: present amongst all men, &c.
नारायणक्षेत्र: नारायणक्षेत्र n. (-त्रं) Four cubits on either side of the stream of the Ganges. E. नारायण, and क्षेत्र shrine.
नारायणतैल: नारायणतैल n. (-लं) An oil of great reputed efficacy in many complaints, expressed from a variety of plants. E. नारायण, and तैल oil.
नारायणप्रिय: नारायणप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Attached to KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU. m. (-यः) ŚIVA. E. नारायण, and प्रिय fond of.
नारायणास्त्र: नारायणास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) A weapon of undefined form and mystical nature. E. नारायण, and अस्त्र weapon.
नारिक: नारिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Watery, aqueous. 2 Spiritual. E. नर or नार, and ठक् aff.
नारिकेर: नारिकेर m. (-रः) The cocoanut: see the next.
नारिकेल: नारिकेल mf. (-लः-ली) The cocoanut. E. नारिक watery (place), ईर to go or grow, affix क, and र optionally changed to ल; also with इन, नारिकेलि, and ड being substituted for र, नाडिकेर, &c.
नारी: नारी f. (-री) 1 A woman in general, a female. 2 A species of the Madhya metre. E. नर a man, अञ् and ङीप् aff.
नारीकवच: नारीकवच m. (-चः) A king of the solar line, the son of AŚMAKA.
नारीकेल: नारीकेल mf. (-लः-ली) The cocoanut. f. (-ली) Fermented liquor made from the water of the cocoanut: see नारिकेल, &c.
नारीच: नारीच n. (-चं) An esculent root, Arum colocasia: see नाडीच.
नारीतरङ्गक: नारीतरङ्गक m. (-कः) A catamite. E. नारी a woman, तरङ्ग capricious, and कन् affix of comparison.
नारीदूषण: नारीदूषण n. (-णं) A vice or breach of duty in a woman, of which six cases are reckoned, drinking spirits, keeping bad company, quitting a husband, rambling abroad, and sleeping or dwelling in a strange house. E. नारी a woman, दूषण defect.
नारीप्रसङ्ग: नारीप्रसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Libertinism, lechery. E. नारी, and प्रसङ्ग addiction.
नारीयान: नारीयान n. (-नं) A litter or other conveyance for women. E. नारी, and यान a carriage.
नार्यङ्ग: नार्य्यङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The orange tree; also नागरङ्ग.
नार्य्यङ्ग: नार्य्यङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The orange tree; also नागरङ्ग.
नाल: नाल mfn. (-लः-ला or ली-लं) 1 A hollow or tubular stalk, the stalk of the water lily, &c. 2 Any pipe or tube. n. (-लं) Yellow orpiment. f. (-ली) 1 A stalk or culm. 2 An instrument for perforating an elephant's ear. 3 A period of time, a Ghari, twentyfour minutes. 4 Any tubular vessel of the body. 5 The pulse. E. णल to bind, affix ण, fem. affix टाप्, and ङीष्, &c.
नालि: नालि f. (-लिः) Any tubular vessel of the body. E. ल interchanged with डः see नाडि.
नालिक: नालिक m. (-कः) A buffalo. n. (-कं) A lotus. f. (-का) 1 A tubular stalk. 2 An instrument for piercing an elephant's ear. 3 A plant, commonly Carmaghās. 4 A sort of potherb, (Hibiscus cannabinus.) 5 Any plant growing on a hollow stem, as Śaṇa, safflower, a mushroom, &c. E. नाली as above, and कन् aff.
नालिकेर: नालिकेर m. (-रः) The cocoanut. E. नल to bind, affix इन, नालि a leaf, &c. क air, wind, and इर what goes; fluttering in the wind.
नालिजङ्घ: नालिजङ्घ m. (-ङ्घः) A raven or the carrion crow. E. नालि a tube, and जङ्घा the leg.
नालिता: नालिता f. (-ता) An esculent root, (Arum colocasia.)
नालीक: नालीक m. (-कः) 1 An arrow. 2 A dart, a javelin, a pike. 3 A lotus. 4 The fibrous stalk of the lotus. n. (-कं) An assemblage of lotus flowers. E. नाली a fibrous stalk, affix ठन्.
नालीकिनी: नालीकिनी f. (-नी) A multitude of lotus flowers. E. नालीक, and इनि aff.
नालीव्रण: नालीव्रण m. (-णः) A fistulous or sinous sore: see नाडीव्रण, ल and ड being interchanged.
नावमिक: नावमिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Ninth. E. नवम and ठञ्.
नाविक: नाविक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging to a vessel, a boat, &c. m. (-कः) 1 The helmsman of a vessel, the steersman, the pilot. 2 A sailor. E. नौ a boat, affix ठन्.
नाव्य: नाव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 Navigable. 2 Belonging to a boat. n. (-व्यं) Newness, novelty. E. नौ a boat or vessel, and यक् affix; or नव new, ष्यञ् aff.
नाश: नाश m. (-शः) 1 Annihilation, loss, destruction, disappearance. 2 Death. 3 Flight, retreat. 4 Abandonment, desertion. (In Arithmetic,) 5 Elimination. E. णश to cease to be, affix धञ्.
नाशन: नाशन n. (-नं) Destruction, perishing. E. णश to perish, affix ल्युट्.
नाशयत्: नाशयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Destroying, annihilating. E. णश to perish, causal form, शतृ aff.
नाशित: नाशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Destroyed. E. नश to perish, causal form, क्त aff.
नाशिन्: नाशिन् mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि) 1 Destructive, destroying, a destroyer. 2 Perishing, being lost or destroyed. E. नश to cease to be, in the causal form, affix इनि; or नाश, and इनि aff.
नाष्टिक: नाष्टिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Belonging or relating to any thing lost. m. (-कः) The owner of any thing lost. E. नष्ट, and ठक् aff.
नासत्य: नासत्य m. du. (-त्यौ) The two sons of AŚVINĪ, and physicians of Svarga. f. (-त्या) The constellation AŚVINĪ. E. न not, असत्य impure.
नासा: नासा f. (-सा) 1 The nose. 2 The upper timber of a door. E. णस to sound, to stand, अच् aff.
नासाच्छिन्नी: नासाछिन्नी f. (-न्नी) A sort of bird; also पूर्णिका. E. नासा the nose, छिन्न cut, fem. affix ङीप्.
नासाछिन्नी: नासाछिन्नी f. (-न्नी) A sort of bird; also पूर्णिका. E. नासा the nose, छिन्न cut, fem. affix ङीप्.
नासादक्षिणावर्त्त: नासादक्षिणावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) Wearing the nose-ring in the right nostril by women who have money and children. E. नासा the nose, दक्षिण the right, and आवर्त्त a turning.
नासादारु: नासादारु m. (-रुः) The upper timber of a door: see नासा.
नासानाह: नासानाह m. (-हः) Thickening of the membrane of the nose, stoppage of the nostrils. E. नासा, and नाह binding.
नासापरिस्राव: नासापरिस्राव n. (-वः) Running at the nose. E. नासा, and परिस्राव flow.
