निर्वेष्टन: निर्वेष्टन n. (-नं) A small reed used as a shuttle. E. निर् without, वेष्टन surrounding.
निर्वैर: निर्वैर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Friendly, without enmity. E. निर् neg. वैर hostility.
निर्व्यथन: निर्व्यथन n. (-नं) 1 A hole, a chasm. 2 Exemption from pain. 3 Paining, afflicting. E. निर् affix or neg, prefix, and न्यथन fear, dread.
निर्व्यपेक्ष: निर्व्यपेक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Indifferent to, disregarding. E. निर् neg. व्यपेक्षा expectation.
निर्व्यलीक: निर्व्यलीक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Undissembling, true. E. निर् neg. व्यलीक false.
निर्व्याज: निर्व्याज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 1 Without deceit. 2 Without obstruction. E. निर् neg. व्याज deceit.
निर्व्यूढ: निर्व्यूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Abandoned, left, deserted. 2 Finished, completed. E. निर् before व्यूढ arranged.
निर्हरण: निर्हरण m. (-णं) 1 Taking forth or out. 2 Removing entirely. 2 Setting apart. 4 Burning dead bodies, or carrying them out to be burnt. E. निर् away, हरण taking.
निर्हार: निर्हार m. (-रः) 1 Extracting, drawing out, rooting up, &c. 2 Putting forth or out. 3 Evacuation of any of the natural excrements of the fæces, urine, sweat, &c. 4 Burning, combustion. 5 Giving away, selling, exchanging, &c. 6 Diffusive fragrance. 7 Accumulation of wealth, a hoard, a private purse or hoard. E. निर् out, हृ to take, affix घञ्.
निर्हारिन्: निर्हारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Taking forth or out. 2 Diffusively fragrant, having a wide spreading odour. 3 Having wealth. E. निर्, हृ to take, घिणुन् aff. or निर्हार, affix इनि.
निर्हृत: निर्हृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Taken or carried forth or out. 2 Extracted. E. निर् out, हृत taken.
निर्हृत्य: निर्हृत्य ind. 1 Having taken forth or out. 2 Having extracted. E. निर् before हृ to take, ल्यप् aff.
निर्हेति: निर्हेति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Unarmed. E. निर्, and हेति a weapon.
निर्ह्राद: निर्ह्राद m. (-दः) Sound in general. E. निर् before ह्रद to sound, affix घञ्.
निलय: निलय m. (-यः) A house, a habitation. E. नि in, ली to embrace, affix घ.
निलयन: निलयन n. (-नं) Place, dwelling. E. नि before ली to endeavour, ल्युट् aff.
निलायिता: निलायिता f. (-ता) Dwelling, domesticality. E. निलायिन्, and तल् aff.
निलायिन्: निलायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Dwelling in, inhabiting. E. नि before ली to embrace, णिनि aff.
निलिम्प: निलिम्प m. (-म्पः) A deity. f. (-म्पा) A cow. E. नि in or on, लिम्प to smear, affix खञ्.
निलिम्पिका: निलिम्पिका f. (-का) A cow. E. कन् added to the preceding.
निलीन: निलीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Encompassed, surrounded, shut or wrapt up, embraced. 2 Destroyed, perished entirely. 3 Transformed, changed. 4 Fused in or into. 5 Full. E. नि in or on, ली to embrace, affix क्त, deriv. irr.
निवपन: निवपन n. (-नं) Gifts in honour of deceased ancestors; also निवाप.
निवरा: निवरा f. (-रा) A virgin, a girl unmarried. E. नि priv. and वर a husband.
निवर्तन: निवर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Returning, turning or coming back. 2 Bringing back. 3 Reforming, repenting. 4 Desisting from. 5 Giving back, returning. 6 Stopping, ceasing. 7 A measure of land 20 rods, or 200 cubits square. E. नि before वृत to be, ल्युट् aff.
निवर्त्तन: निवर्त्तन n. (-नं) 1 Returning, turning or coming back. 2 Bringing back. 3 Reforming, repenting. 4 Desisting from. 5 Giving back, returning. 6 Stopping, ceasing. 7 A measure of land 20 rods, or 200 cubits square. E. नि before वृत to be, ल्युट् aff.
निवर्तयितव्य: निवर्त्तयितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be restrained, to be hindered or diverted. E. नि before वृत to be, causal v. तव्य aff.
निवर्त्तयितव्य: निवर्त्तयितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be restrained, to be hindered or diverted. E. नि before वृत to be, causal v. तव्य aff.
निवर्त्त्य: निवर्त्त्य ind. 1 Having desisted or refrained from. 2 Having turned back. 3 Having repented. 4 Having repaid. E. नि before ष्टत to be, aff. ल्यप्.
निवर्हण: निवर्हण nf. (-णं-णा) 1 Killing, destroying. 2 Removing. E. नि before वर्ह to cover, ल्युट् aff.
निवर्हित: निवर्हित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Killed, destroyed. 2 Removed, taken away. E. नि before वर्ह to cover, क्त aff.
निवसत्: निवसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) Dwelling in, inhabiting. E. नि before वस to dwell, शतृ aff.
निवसति: निवसति f. (-तिः) A house, a habitation. E. नि in, वस to dwell, aff. क्तिन्.
निवसथ: निवसथ m. (-थः) A village. E. नि in, वस to dwell, aff. अथ.
निवसन: निवसन n. (-नं) 1 A house, a habitation. 2 Cloth, clothes, raiment. E. नि in, वस to dwell or wear, aff. ल्युट्.
निवह: निवह m. (-हः) 1 A multitude, a quantity. 2 One of the seven winds. E. नि always, वह to gain, घ or अच् aff.
निवात: निवात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Well armed, accoutred in strong mail. 2 Secure, safe, as in an asylum. 3 Calm, not windy. m. (-तः) An asylum, a dwelling, &c. 2 A calm. 3 Strong armour. E. नि neg. वात wind, &c.
निवातकवच: निवातकवच m. (-चः) A demon, the grandson of HIRAṆYAKAŚIPU. E. निवात, and कवच a cuirass.
निवाप: निवाप m. (-पः) 1 Gifts in honour of a deceased parent or relative. 2 Offering of water at Śrāddhas, or daily ablution to the manes. 3 Gift, giving in general. E. नि before वप to go, to give, &c. aff. घञ्.
निवार: निवार m. (-रः) Hindering, opposition, impediment. E. नि prefix, वॄ to screen, घञ् aff.
निवारण: निवारण n. (-णं) 1 Hindering, opposing. 2 An impediment. 3 Contemning, holding light or worthless. E. नि prefix, वॄ to screen, ल्युट् aff.
निवारणीय: निवारणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be checked, hindered, &c. E. नि before वॄ to screen, aff. अनीयर्; also निवारितव्य and निवार्य्य.
निवारयत्: निवारयत् mfn. (-यत्-यन्ती-यत्) Opposing, hindering. E. नि before वॄ to screen, शतृ aff.
निवारित: निवारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Hindered, checked, opposed. E. नि prefix, वॄ to screen, क्त aff.
निवार्यमाण: निवार्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) To be opposed or hindered. E. नि before वॄ to screen, pass. v. शानच् aff.
निवार्य्यमाण: निवार्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) To be opposed or hindered. E. नि before वॄ to screen, pass. v. शानच् aff.
निवास: निवास m. (-सः) A house, a dwelling. E. नि in, वस to abide, aff. घञ्.
निवासभूय: निवासभूय n. (-यं) Habitation or inhabiting. E. निवास, and भूय being.
निवासिन्: निवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Dwelling, abiding in, inhabiting. E. निवास, and इनि aff.
निविड: निविड mfn. (-डः-डा-डं) 1 Coarse, large, gross, bulky, without spaces or interstices. 2 Thick, impervious, impenetrable. 3 Crooked-nosed. E. नि not, विल an interstice, ल changed to ड; or नि particle, with विलच् aff.
निविडीष: निविडीष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) 1 Coarse, gross. 2 Crooked-nosed. E. see the last; also मि particle, विडीसच् aff.
निविवृत्सत्: निविवृत्सत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्) Wishing to stop or return. E. नि before वृत to abide, desid. form, शतृ aff.
निविशेष: निविशेष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Alike, not different. E. नि neg. विशेष difference.
निविष्ट: निविष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Entered, gone in or into. 2 Seated, sitting upon. 3 Situated or placed in or on. E. नि before विश to enter, aff. क्त.
निवीत: निवीत mfn. subst. (-तः-ता-तं) A veil, a mantle, a wrapper. n. (-तं) The Brahminical thread suspended round the neck, in which manner it is worn on some occasions. E. नि before व्ये to cover, aff. क्त.
निवीतिन्: निवीतिन् m. (-ती) A Brahman with the cord suspended round his neck. E. निवीत, and इनि aff.
निवृत: निवृत mfn. adj. (-तः-ता-तं) Surrounded, enclosed, encompassed. subst. A veil, a mantle, a wrapper. E. नि before वृ to surround, aff. क्त.
निवृति: निवृति f. (-तिः) Covering, enclosing. E. नि, वृ to be, क्तिन् aff.
निवृत्त: निवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) 1 Ceased, stopped. 2 Abstaining from worldly acts, &c. 3 Abstracted from or independant of worldly motives. 3 Desisting from or repenting of any improper conduct. 4 Returned, turned back. 5 Gone, departed. 6 Finished, completed. E. नि prohibitory prefix, वृत to be, aff. क्त; see निर्वृत्त.
निवृत्तकारण: निवृत्तकारण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Without further cause or motive. m. (-णः) A virtuous man, one uninfluenced by worldly desires. E. निवृत्त ceased, कारण cause.
निवृत्तराग: निवृत्तराग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Of subdued appetites or passions. E. निवृत्त stopped, राग passion.
निवृत्तवृत्ति: निवृत्तवृत्ति mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति) Quitting any practice or occupation. E. निवृत्त, and वृत्ति maintenance.
निवृत्तात्मन्: निवृत्तात्मन् m. (-त्मा) 1 A sage. 2 VIṢṆU. E. निवृत्त stopped, (from worldly acts, &c.) आत्मन् spirit.
निवृत्ति: निवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Cessation, completion, leaving off, rest, repose. 2 Discontinuance of worldly acts, cessation of emotions, separation from the world. 3 Denial, refusal. 4 Abolition, prevention. 5 Returning. E. नि negative prefix, वृत to be, aff. क्तिन्: see निर्वृत्ति.
निवेदन: निवेदन n. (-नं) 1 Delivering, giving, entrusting, addressing, (either an article, a message, or a speech.) E. नि before विद to know, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.
निवेदित: निवेदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Given, entrusted, addressed, delivered. 2 Represented, stated, told. E. नि before विद to know, aff. क्तः see निवेदन.
निवेश: निवेश m. (-शः) 1 Entrance, entering. 2 Delivering, entrusting, depositing. 3 A camp, a palace, the residence of a king or general. 4 Any dwelling. 5 Military array. 6 Ornament, dress, decoration. 7 Marriage. E. नि before विश to enter, aff. घञ्.
निवेशन: निवेशन n. (-नं) 1 Entering, entrance. 2 A house, a habitation. 3 A town or city. E. नि before विश to enter, aff. ल्युट्.
निवेशनीय: निवेशनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be entered. 2 To be engaged in. E. नि before विश to enter, अनीयर् aff; also निवेशितव्य and निवेश्य.
निवेशयत्: निवेशयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Sending in or into, causing to enter. E. नि before विश to enter, causal form, शतृ aff.
निवेशित: निवेशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Entered into. 2 Engaged in. 3 Sent, directed. 4 Placed in or upon. 5 Turned to or towards, fixed upon. E. नि before विश to enter, क्त aff.
निव्यूढ: निव्यूढ n. (-ढं) Perseverance, resolution. E. नि, and व्यूढ arranged.
निशठ: निशठ m. (-ठः) The son of BALARĀMA.
निशमन: निशमन n. (-नं) 1 Sight, seeing. 2 Hearing. E. नि before शम to be quiet, aff. ल्युट्.
निशम्य: निशम्य ind. Hearing, having heard. E. नि, शम to repose, ल्यप् aff.
निशमयत्: निशमयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Hearing. E. नि before शम to rest, शतृ aff.
निशमय्य: निशमय्य ind. (-य्यः) Having heard. E. नि before शमु to repose, ल्यप् aff., and अय inserted.
निशा: निशा f. (-शा) 1 Night. 2 Turmerick, (Curcuma longa.) 3 Another sort, (C. zanthorrhiza) E. नि always, शो to waste or reduce, (mortals,) aff. क; or निश to meditate, aff. क्विप् and टाप् added.
निशाकर: निशाकर m. (-रः) 1 The moon. 2 A cock. E. निशा night, and कर who makes or marks.
निशाकेतु: निशाकेतु m. (-तुः) The moon. E. निशा night, and केतु symbol.
निशागण: निशागण m. (-णः) A number of nights. E. निशा A night, and गण a class, a troop.
निशाचर: निशाचर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Nocturnal, night-walking, what goes or moves about by night. m. (-रः) 1 A Rākṣasa, a fiend, an imp or goblin. 2 A Shakāl. 3 An owl. 4 A snake. 5 The ruddy goose. 6 A ghost, an evil spirit. 7 A thief. f. (-री) 1 A woman who goes to an assignation, a harlot, a whore. 2 A she devil, a female fiend. 3 A sort of perfume: see केशिनी. E. निशा night, and चर् who goes.
निशाचर्मन्: निशाचर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Darkness. E. निशा night, and चर्म्मन् skin or hide.
निशाचर्म्मन्: निशाचर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Darkness. E. निशा night, and चर्म्मन् skin or hide.
निशाजल: निशाजल n. (-लं) 1 Frost, hoar frost. 2 Dew. E. निशा night, and जल water.
निशाट: निशाट m. (-टः) 1 An owl. 2 A demon, a ghost. E. निशा night, and अट who goes; also with ल्यु aff. निशाटन m. (-नः.)
निशात: निशात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sharpened, polished, whetted, burnished. E. नि before शो to cut or pare, aff. क्त.
निशाद: निशाद m. (-दः) A man of a low caste: see निषाद.
निशादत्व: निशादत्व n. (-त्वं) The state or condition of a man of low caste.
निशादर्शिन्: निशादर्शिन् m. (-र्शी) An owl. E. निशा night, and दर्शिन् who sees.
निशादि: निशादि f. (-दिः) Evening, twilight. E. निशा, and आदि beginning.
निशान्त: निशान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Quiet, tranquil, patient. n. (-न्तं) 1 A house, a dwelling. 2 The end of the night, or break of day. E. नि before शम to be quiet, aff. क्त; or निशा night, अम to go, aff. क्त; or निशा as before, night, and अन्त end or term.
निशान्तनारी: निशान्तनारी f. (-री) A female, a housewife. E. निशान्त a house, नारी a woman.
निशान्ध: निशान्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Blind at night. E. निशा, and अन्ध blind.
निशापति: निशापति m. (-तिः) 1 The moon. 2 Camphor. E. निशा night, and पति master.
निशापुष्प: निशापुष्प n. (-ष्पं) 1 Hoar frost. 2 Dew. 3 The white water lily. E. निशा, and पुष्प a flower.
निशाभङ्गा: निशाभङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) A plant commonly Dugdhapeya. E. निशा night, भङ्ग breaking.
निशामणि: निशामणि m. (-णिः) The moon. E. निशा night, and मणि a gem.
निशामन: निशामन n. (-नं) 1 Sight, seeing. 2 Looking at, beholding. 3 Looking at repeatedly. 4 Hearing. 5 A shadow, a reflexion. E. नि before शम to quiet, aff. ल्युट्.
निशामृग: निशामृग m. (-गः) A Shakāl. E. निशा night, and मृग a deer.
निशाम्य: निशाम्य ind. Having put out, (as a light.) 2 Having tranquillized. E. नि before शम to be quiet, causal form, ल्यप् aff.
निशारण: निशारण n. (-णं) 1 Killing, slaying, slaughter. 2 Night combat. E. नि before शृ to injure or kill, aff. ल्युट्; or निशा night, and रण war.
निशारत्न: निशारत्न m. (-त्नः) The moon. E. निशा night, and रत्न jewel.
निशारुक: निशारुक n. (-कं) An air, a sort of musical composition, played as an accompaniment to dancing.
निशावृन्द: निशावृन्द n. (-न्दं) A number of nights. E. निशा, and वृन्द a many.
निशावेदिन्: निशावेदिन् m. (-दी) A cock. E. निशा night, and वेदिन् who knows.
निशाहस: निशाहस m. (-सः) The white water lily. E. निशा, and हस what smiles; opening its petals at night.
निशाह्वा: निशाह्वा f. (-ह्वा) Turmerick. E. निशा, and आह्वा appellation.
निशित: निशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sharpened, whetted. n. (-तं) Iron. E. नि before शो to pare, affix क्त.
निशिपुष्पा: निशिपुष्पा f. (-ष्पा) A flower, (Nyctanthes tristis.) E. निशि by night, seventh case of निश्, and पुष्प flower, fem. affix टाप्; also with ङीप् affix निशिपुष्पी, and with कन् added निशिपुष्पिका the night-flower.
निशीथ: निशीथ n. (-थः) 1 Midnight. 2 Night. E. नि always, शी to sleep, Uṇādi affix थक्.
निशीथिनी: निशीथिनी f. (-नी) Night. E. निशीथ as above, इनि aff.
निशीथिनीनाथ: निशीथिनीनाथ m. (-थः) The moon. E. निशीथिनी night, and नाथ lord.
निशीथ्या: निशीथ्या f. (-थ्या) Night. E. निशीथ midnight, and यत् aff.
निशुम्भ: निशुम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 Killing, slaughter. 2 The name of a giant slain by DURGĀ. E. नि before शुम्भ to hurt or kill, aff. घञ्.
निशुम्भन: निशुम्भन n. (-नं) Killing, slaying, slaughter. E. see the last, aff. ल्युट्.
निशुम्भमर्दिनी: निशुम्भमर्द्दिनी f. (-नी) A name of DURGĀ. E. निशुम्भ an Asura or demon so named, and मर्द्दिनी the female destroyer.
निशुम्भमर्द्दिनी: निशुम्भमर्द्दिनी f. (-नी) A name of DURGĀ. E. निशुम्भ an Asura or demon so named, and मर्द्दिनी the female destroyer.
निशुम्भिन्: निशुम्भिन् m. (-म्भी) An inferior deity of the Bauddhas; also Heramba and Vajraṭīka. E. नि not, शुम्भ injuring, aff. इनि.
निशोपशाय: निशोपशाय m. (-यः) Resting at night. E. निशा, and उपशाय rest.
निशैत: निशैत m. (-तः) The Vaka, a crane, (Ardea nivea.) E. निशा by night, इत gone, to his roost.
निश्चय: निश्चय m. (-यः) Certainty, ascertainment, positive conclusion. E. निर् affirmative particle, चि to collect, aff. अप्.
निश्चल: निश्चल mfn. (-लः-ला-ली-लं) Immoveable, still, fixed. f. (-ला) The earth. E. निर् privat. चल what goes or moves.
निश्चलाङ्ग: निश्चलाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Firm, immoveable. m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A kind of crane, (Ardea nivea.) 2 A mountain, a rock. E. निश्चल, and अङ्ग body.
निश्चायक: निश्चायक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what ascertains or determines. E. निर् before चि to collect, ण्वुल् aff.
निश्चारक: निश्चारक m. (-कः) 1 Evacuation by stool. 2 Air, wind. 3 Obstinacy, wilfulness. E. निर् not, चर to go, aff. ण्वुल्.
निश्चित: निश्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Certain, ascertained, determined, concluded. 2 Sentenced, pronounced. n. (-तं) Certainty, conclusion. E. निर् before चि to collect, क्त aff.
निश्चित्य: निश्चित्य ind. Having ascertained. E. निर aff. चि to collect, ल्यप् aff.
निश्चिन्त: निश्चिन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Thoughtless, inconsiderate, void of reflexion. E. निर् neg. चिन्ता reflexion.
निश्चीयमान: निश्चीयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being in the course of ascertainment or conclusion, being under investigation. E. निर before चि to collect, शानच् aff., यक् inserted.
निश्चुक्कण: निश्चुक्कण n. (-णं) A sort of tooth-powder prepared of sulphate of iron, &c. it destroys the tartar, but blackens the teeth. E. निर् before चुक्क to give pain, aff. ल्युट्.
निश्चेष्ट: निश्चेष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Powerless, helpless. 2 Incapable of effort. E. निर् neg. चेष्टा effort.
निश्श्रेयस: निश्श्रेयस n. (-सं) Final emancipation: see निःश्रेयस.
निश्श्रेयसकर: निश्श्रेयसकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Conferring final happiness or emancipation. E. निश्श्रेयस, and कर what makes.
निश्श्वसन: निश्श्वसन n. (-नं) 1 Breathing out, expiration. 2 Sighing. E. निर् forth, and श्वसन breathing.
निश्श्वास: निश्श्वास m. (-सः) 1 Breath expired, breathing out, expiration. E. निर् out, and श्वास breath.
निष: निष (उ) निषु r. 1st cl. (नेषति) To sprinkle.
निषङ्ग: निषङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A quiver. 2 Union, meeting, association. E. नि before सञ्ज to embrace, aff. घञ् a collection of arrows, &c.
निषङ्गथि: निषङ्गथि m. (-थिः) 1 Embracing, an embrace. 2 A bowman. 3 A charioteer. 4 A car. 5 Grass. 6 The shoulder. E. नि before सञ्ज to embrace, aff. घ and थिन् Uṇādi aff. added.
निषङ्गिन्: निषङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) An archer, a bowman. E. निषङ्ग a quiver, and इनि aff.
निषद: निषद m. (-दः) A musical note: see निषाद.
निषद्या: निषद्या f. (-द्या) 1 A market. 2 A small bed. E. नि before षद to go, क्यप् aff.
निषद्वर: निषद्वर m. (-रः) Mud, mire. f. (-री) Night. E. नि before षद to go, Uṇādi aff. ष्वरच्.
निषध: निषध m. (-धः) 1 The name of a mountain or mountainous range, forming one of the principal ranges of the universe, and described as lying immediately south of Hāvrata, and north of the Himāla range. 2 A country in the south-east division of India. 3 The sovereign of Niṣadha. 4 A musical note; also निषाद्र. 5 Hard, solid. E. नि before षद to go, aff. अच् and द irregularly changed to ध.
निषण्ण: निषण्ण mfn. (-ण्णः-ण्णा-ण्णं) 1 Placed in or on. 2 Gone to. 3 Rested, reclined. E. नि before षद to go, क्त aff.
निषण्णक: निषण्णक mfn. (-कः-का-खं) Seating, seated. m. (-कं) A seat. E. कन् added to the last.
निषन्नक: निषन्नक m. (-कः) A sort of potherb, (Marsilea dentata.)
निषाद: निषाद m. (-दः) 1 The first of the seven musical notes, or more properly the last or highest of the scale. 2 A man of a degraded tribe, or an outcaste, especially the son of a Brahman by a Śūdra woman. 3 A fisherman. E. नि before षद to go, aff, घञ्; pervading the mind, &c.
निषादिन्: निषादिन् m. (-दी) An elephant keeper or driver. E. नि before षद to go, aff. णिनि.
निषिद्ध: निषिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Prohibited, forbidden. E. नि priv. सिध to complete, aff. क.
निषीदत्: निषीदत् mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्) 1 Sitting, sitting upon. 2 Standing or resting in or on. E. नि before षद to go, शतृ aff.
निषूदन: निषूदन n. (-नं) Killing, slaughter. E. नि before षद to kill, aff. ल्युट्.
निषेक: निषेक m. (-कः) 1 The ceremony performed upon impregnation taking place. 2 Sprinkling, aspersion. 3 Effusion. 4 Seminal effusion. E. नि, and षिच to sprinkle, aff. घञ्.
निषेदिवस्: निषेदिवस् mfn. (-वान्-दुषी-वस्) Sitting, seated on or upon. E. नि before सद to go, क्वसु aff.
निषेध: निषेध n. (-धः) 1 Prohibition, negation. 2 Stop, discontinuance. 3 Contrariety to or deviation from rule, irregularity, exception. E. नि before सिध to complete, aff. घञ्.
निषेवन: निषेवन n. (-नं) 1 Service. 2 Observance, practice, adherence to. E. नि before सेव to serve, ल्युट् aff.
निषेवनीय: निषेवनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be served, to be obeyed. 2 To be observed or followed. E. नि before सेव to serve, अनीयर् aff.; also निषेवितव्य, and निषेव्य.
निषेवित: निषेवित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Observed, practised. 2 Served, obeyed. 3 Frequented through respect. E. नि before सेव to serve, क्त aff.
निष्क: निष्क r. 10th cl. (निष्कयते) To measure or weigh.

निष्क mn. (-ष्कः-ष्कं) 1 A weight of gold, applied however to different quantities: it is considered as synonymous with the Dīnāra of thirty-two small, or sixteen large Rettīs; with the Karṣa or Suvarṇa of sixteen Māṣas; with the Pala of four or five Suvarṇas; and with the larger Pala or Dināra, which is sometimes reckoned at 108, and other times at 150 Suvarṇas. 2 Gold in general. 3 Any ornament of the breast. 4 An ornament of the neck. 5 A weight of four Māṣas. 6 A weight of silver of four Suvarṇas. 7 A value of sixteen Kahans or Dramyas. E. नि before षद to go, Uṇādi aff. कन्, and the radical final rejected.
निष्कण्टक: निष्कण्टक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Without thorns. 2 Free from trouble. E. निर् neg. कण्टक a thorn.
निष्कण्ठ: निष्कण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) A plant, (Capparis trifoliata,) &c.: see वरुणा.
निष्कर्मन्: निष्कर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Exempt from or neglecting religious rites, worldly acts, &c. E. निर् neg. कर्म्मन् act.
निष्कर्म्मन्: निष्कर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Exempt from or neglecting religious rites, worldly acts, &c. E. निर् neg. कर्म्मन् act.
निष्करुण: निष्करुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Cruel, unpitying, unmerciful. E. निर् neg. करुण compassionate.
निष्कल: निष्कल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Waned, diminished. 2 Impotent, seedless, barren. m. (-लः) 1 Pudendum muliebre. 2 A name of BRAHMA. 3 A fancied personification of BRAHMA, for religious ceremonies. f. (-ला or -ली) A woman past child bearing, in whom menstruation has ceased. E. निर् gone, lost, कल a part, &c.
निष्कर्ष: निष्कर्ष m. (-र्षः) Certainty, ascertainment. E. निर् before कृष to plough, घञ् aff.
निष्काम: निष्काम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Free from wish or desire. n. adv. (-मं) Unwillingly. E. निर् neg. काम desire.
निष्कारण: निष्कारण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Causeless, groundless. E. निर् neg. कारण cause.
निष्कारुष: निष्कारुष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Of a noble race, not degraded.
निष्कालक: निष्कालक m. (-कः) A penitent, shaved and smeared with Ghee.
निष्काश: निष्काश m. (-शः) A portico, a veranda. E. निर्, and कश to go, घञ् aff.
निष्काशित: निष्काशित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Expelled: see the next.
निष्कासित: निष्कासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Expelled, dismissed, turned out. 2 Gone forth or out, issued. 3 Placed, deposited. 4 Placed over, appointed, stationed. 5 Reviled, reproached. 6 Opened out, blown, expanded. E. निर् out, कस to go, in the causal form, aff. क्त, र becomes ष or Visarga: see निःकासित; also निष्काशित.
निष्कासिन्: निष्कासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Who or what expels. (-नी) A female slave not restrained by her master. E. निर् forth, कस to go, causal form, णिनि aff.
निष्कुट: निष्कुट m. (-टः) 1 A grove near a house. 2 A field. 3 A door. 4 The private apartments, the Zenana. (E. निर् without, कुट the house.) f. (-टा, also टिः or टी) Large cardamoms. E. निर out, कुट the shell or husk, aff. क, with टाप् fem. aff. or कि with ङीष् optionally added.
निष्कुम्भ: निष्कुम्भ m. (-म्भः) A plant, commonly Danti. E. निर् forth, स्कुम्भ a Sautra root, to spread, aff. अच्; also निःकुम्भ.
निष्कुषित: निष्कुषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Expelled, extracted, forced or drawn out. E. निर् neg. कुष to extract, aff. क्त.
निष्कुह: निष्कुह m. (-हः) The hollow of a tree. E. निर् affirmative prefix, कुह to astonish, aff. अच्.
निष्कृत: निष्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Regardless, negligent. 2 Disregarded, thought nothing of. 3 Pardoned. 4 Undone. E. निर् neg. कृत made.
निष्कृति: निष्कृति f. (-तिः) 1 Pardon, absolution. 2 Expiration. 3 Escaping from, avoiding the consequence of any thing. 4 Undoing, doing away. 5 Disregarding, neglecting. 6 Acquittance, compensation, discharge of a debt or obligation. E. निर् neg. कृति doing.
निष्कोषण: निष्कोषण n. (-नं) 1 Taking away. 2 Extracting, extirpating. E. निर् before कुष to expel, aff. ल्युट्.
निष्कोषितव्य: निष्कोषितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be taken away. E. निर् out, कुष to expel, तव्य aff.; also निष्कोषणीय.
निष्क्रम: निष्क्रम m. (-मः) 1 Any intellectual faculty, as attention, comprehension, &c. 2 Degradation, baseness, inferiority of tribe, family, &c. 3 Going out, exit. E. निर् assuredly or forth, and क्रम going.
निष्क्रमण: निष्क्रमण n. (-णं) 1 Going forth or out. 2 Taking a child for the first time out of the house, in the fourth month, considered as an essential ceremony, and accompanied by sacrifice, &c. E. निर् forth, क्रमण going.
निष्क्रम्य: निष्क्रम्य ind. Going forth. E. निर्, क्रम to go, ल्यप् aff.
निष्क्रय: निष्क्रय m. (-यः) Hire, wages. E. निर् before क्री to buy, aff. अच्.
निष्क्रान्त: निष्क्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Gone out, gone, departed. E. निर् out, क्रम to go, aff. क्त.
निष्क्रिय: निष्क्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Abstaining from ceremonial rites. 2 Idle, unoccupied. n. (-यं) BRAHMA or the Supreme Spirit. E. निर् neg. क्रिया act.
निष्क्वाथ: निष्क्वाथ m. (-थः) Broth, soup. E. निर् before क्वथ to decoct, aff. घञ्.
निष्ट्य: निष्ट्य m. (-ष्ट्यः) A man of one of the outcast or barbarous tribes.
निष्टप्त: निष्टप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Well done, dressed or cooked. 2 Burnished, made bright. E. निर्, and तप्त heated.
निष्ठ: निष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) 1 Staying, being in, who or what stays or is in or on any thing. 2 Believing, faithful. f. (-ष्ठा) 1 The catastrophe of a drama, the conclusion of a fable. 2 Conclusion in general, end, termination. 3 Disappearance, loss,  destruction. 4 Confirmation, completion. 5 Asking, begging. 6 Ordinary and uniform practice or profession. 7 Good conduct, excellence. 8 Religious practice, devout and austere exercise. 9 Faith, belief. 10 Condition, state. 11 Fixed time of life, &c. 12 Trouble, distress, anxiety. 13 The technical term for the past participial affixes क्त and क्तवतु. E. नि completely, assuredly, स्था to stay or stop, अङ् and टाप affs.
निष्ठान: निष्ठान n. (-नं) Sauce, condiment. E. नि before स्था to stay, aff. ल्युट्.
निष्ठित: निष्ठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Firm, fixed. 2 Certain, ascertained. 3 Engaged in, attached to, devoted to. 4 Staying, being in or on. E. नि before स्था to stay, क्त aff.
निष्ठीवन: निष्ठीवन m. (-नं) Spitting, spitting out, ejecting any thing from the mouth. E. नि before ष्ठिव to eject, aff. ल्युट्; also निष्ठेवन and निष्ठीव.
निष्ठुर: निष्ठुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Harsh, contumelious, (as speech.) 2 Hard, solid. E. नि before स्था to be, to be firm, aff. कुरच्.
निष्ठुरता: निष्ठुरता f. (-ता) Harshness of speech, reviling, abuse. E. निष्ठुर, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, निष्ठुरत्व.
निष्ठ्यूत: निष्ठ्यूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Cast, thrown, sent, directed, dispatched. 2 Ejected from the mouth, spit. E. नि before ष्ठिव to eject, aff. क्त, deriv. irr.
निष्ठ्यूति: निष्ठ्यूति f. (-तिः) Spitting, spitting out. E. नि before ष्ठिव to eject from the mouth, aff. क्त.
निष्ठेव: निष्ठेव subst. mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Spitting, spitting out, ejecting any thing from the mouth. E. नि before ष्ठिव to eject, aff. घञ्; also निष्ठीव.
निष्ठेवन: निष्ठेवन n. (-नं) Spitting. E. see the last; also निष्ठीव.
निष्ण: निष्ण mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं) Skilful, &c. see the next.
निष्णात: निष्णात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Skilful, clever, conversant, learned. 2 Perfect, superior, supreme. 3 (In law,) Agreed upon. E. नि before स्ना to bathe, aff. क्त; also with ड, निष्ण.
निष्पक्व: निष्पक्व mfn. (-क्वः-क्वा-क्वं) Decocted, infused, boiled. E. निर् before पक्व ripe or cooked.
निष्पङ्क: निष्पङ्क mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं) Pure, free from mud or filth. E. निर् neg. पङ्क mud.
निष्पतत्: निष्पतत् mfn. (-तन्-तन्ती-तत्) Issuing, going forth or out. E. निर् before पत to go, शतृ aff.
निष्पतन: निष्पतन n. (-नं) Going forth or out, issuing. E. निर्, and पतन going.
निष्पत्ति: निष्पत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Completion, conclusion, termination, consummation. 2 Birth, production. 3 Going forth or out. E. निर् negative, पद to go, aff. क्तिन्.
निष्पन्द: निष्पन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) Motionless. E. निर् not, स्पदि to shake or move, aff. अच्; also निष्पन्न.
निष्पन्न: निष्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Done, finished, concluded, completed. 2 Born, produced. 3 Motionless. 4 Gone forth or out of. E. निर् affirmation or negation, and पन्न gone, from पद to go, aff. क्त.
निष्पराक्रम: निष्पराक्रम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Weak, destitute of power. E. निर् neg. पराक्रम valour.
निष्परिग्रह: निष्परिग्रह m. (-हः) An ascetic, one who has no family nor dependants. E. निर् neg. परिग्रह dependants.
निष्पादन: निष्पादन nf. (-नं-ना) 1 Doing, effecting, accomplishing. 2 Concluding. 3 Producing, causing, engendering. E. निर् forth, पद to go, causal form, aff. युच्.
निष्पादित: निष्पादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Done, effected, made, produced. E. निर् forth, पद to go, causal form, क्त aff.
निष्पाद्य: निष्पाद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) To be done, to be effected or accomplished. E. निर् forth, पद to go, causal form, यत् aff.; also निष्पादनीय and निष्पादयितव्य.
निष्पाद्यमान: निष्पाद्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Being done or made, in the course of completion. E. निर् before पद to go, causal form, शानच् aff.
निष्पान: निष्पान n. (-नं) Drinking. E. निर् before पान drinking.
निष्पाव: निष्पाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Certain, indubitable. m. (-वः) 1 Winnowing, cleaning corn, &c. 2 Wind, air. 3 The wind of the winnowing sieve or basket. 4 Straw, chaff. 5 A legume, a pod. 6 A sort of pulse, (Phaseolus radiatus.) E. निर् before पू to purify, aff. घञ्.
निष्पिष्ट: निष्पिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Ground, reduced to dust or powder. 2 Beaten, oppressed. E. निर्, and पिष्ट ground.
निष्पुत्त्र: निष्पुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः-त्त्रा-त्त्रं) Sonless. E. निर्, and पुन्त्र a son.
निष्पुरुष: निष्पुरुष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Feminine, neuter, not male. m. (-षः) 1 A eunuch or impotent man. 2 A coward. E. निर् neg. पुरुष a man.
निष्प्रतिभ: निष्प्रतिभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Stupid, frigid, dull, apathetic, ignorant. E. निर् privative, प्रतिभ brilliance.
निष्प्रत्यूह: निष्प्रत्यूह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Unobstructed, unimpeded. n. adv. (-हं) Freely, without hindrance. E. निर् neg. प्रत्यूह obstacle.
निष्प्रभ: निष्प्रभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Gloomy, dark, obscure. E. निर् privative, and प्रभा light.
निष्प्रयोजन: निष्प्रयोजन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Causeless, groundless. E. निर् negative, प्रयोजन motive, cause.
निष्पृह: निष्पृह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Content, not envying any person, nor coveting any thing. f. (-हा) A plant; also अमूला and विष्णुघल्लभा. E. निर् not, स्पृहा envy, &c.
निष्प्रवाण: निष्प्रवाण mfn. subst. (-णः-णी-णं) New and unbleached cloth. E. निर् gone, प्रकाणी here said to mean the weaver's brush; also निष्प्रवाणि mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि) the forms are irregular.
निष्फल: निष्फल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Barren, unfruitful. 2 Seedless, impotent. f. (-ला or -ली) A woman past child bearing, one in whom menstruation has ceased: see निष्कल. E. निर् priv. and फल fruit.
निसर्ग: निसर्ग m. (-र्गः) 1 The natural state, nature, peculiar character or condition. 2 Form. 3 Creation. 4 Relinquishment, abandoning. 5 Transfer, barter. E. नि before सृज to create, or to abandon, aff. घञ्.
निसर्गज: निसर्गज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) 1 Cognate, innate. 2 Produced at creation. E. निसर्ग, and ज produced.
निसिन्धु: निसिन्धु m. (-न्धुः) A shrub, (Vitex negundo;) it is also read निसिन्ध, and with कन् added निसुन्धक; the words are considered as barbarous: see सिन्धुवार.
निसूदन: निसूदन n. (-नं) Killing, slaughter. E. नि before षद to kill, aff, ल्युट्; also निषूदन.
निसृता: निसृता f. (-ता) A plant, commonly Teöri.
निसृष्ट: निसृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Delivered, deposited. 2 Centrical, middle. E. नि before सृज to go, aff. क्त.
निसृष्टार्थ: निसृष्टार्थ m. (-र्थः) A messenger, an envoy, an ambassador: one who decides upon his own discretion, knowing the intentions of both parties. E. निसृष्ट deposited, अर्थ meaning.
निस्तनी: निस्तनी f. (-नी) A pill, a bolus, a sort of force-meat ball. E. नि before स्तन a breast, ङीप् diminutive aff.
निस्तरण: निस्तरण n. (-णं) 1 Going out or forth. 2 Crossing over or passing. 3 Extraction, getting rid of or free from. 4 Means of success, an expedient, a plan. E. निर् before तॄ to cross or pass over, aff. ल्युट्.
निस्तब्ध: निस्तब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) 1 Paralysed, numbed. 2 Stopped, fixed. E. नि before स्तम्भ to stop, aff. क्त.
निस्तर्हण: निस्तर्हण n. (-णं) Killing, slaughter. E. निर् before तृह to kill or hurt, aff. ल्युट्.
निस्तल: निस्तल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Round, globular. 2 Trembling, shaking, moving. 3 Down, below. E. निर् negative or affirmative, and तल a support or stay; or depth, bottom.
निस्तार: निस्तार m. (-रः) 1 Getting over or across. 2 Getting rid of, or away from, extraction, escape. 3 Acquittance, requital. 4 Means, expedient. 5 Final liberation. E. निर्, and तॄ to cross, घञ् aff.
निस्तारवीज: निस्तारवीज n. (-जं) The cause of final liberation, faith in any deity, &c. E. निस्तार, and वीज seed.
निस्तितीर्षत्: निस्तितीर्षत् mfn. (-र्षन्-र्षन्ती-र्षत्) 1 Desirous or anxious to cross. 2 Wishing for salvation, or to traverse the world. E. निर् before तॄ to cross, desid. form, शतृ aff.
निस्तुष: निस्तुष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Freed from the chaff, (corn, &c.) E. निर् neg. तुष chaff.
निस्तुषक्षीर: निस्तुषक्षीर m. (-रः) Wheat. E. निस्तुष, and क्षीर milk.
निस्तुषरत्न: निस्तुषरत्न n. (-त्नं) Crystal. E. निस्तुष, and रत्न a gem.
निस्तुषित: निस्तुषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Left, abandoned, deserted. 2 Skinned, peeled. 3 Pared, made thin. E. निर् before तुष husk or skin, converted into a nominal verb, and क्त participial aff.
निस्तेजस्: निस्तेजस् mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः) 1 Dull, obscure. 2 Dull, spiritless. 3 Powerless, impotent. E. निर् neg. तेजस् light, &c.
निस्त्रंश: निस्त्रंश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Fearless, unapprehensive. E. निर् neg. त्रशि to fear, aff. अच्.
निस्त्रिंश: निस्त्रिंश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Merciless, unfeeling, unpitying. m. (-शः) A scimitar, a sacrificial knife. E. निर् forth, त्रिंशत् thirty, ड aff.; being of thirty finger's length, &c.
निस्त्रिंशधारिन्: निस्त्रिंशधारिन् m. (-री) A soldier armed with a sword. E. निस्त्रिंश, and धारिन् who bears.
निस्त्रैगुण्य: निस्त्रैगुण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) Destitute of the qualities, truth, passion, and darkness. E. निर् neg. त्रैगुण्य three qualities.
निस्नाव: निस्नाव m. (-वः) The remainder of articles, &c. after a sale or market.
निस्पन्द: निस्पन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) Still, steady, immoveable. m. (-न्दः) Throbbing, trembling. E. नि before स्पद to go, aff. अच्.
निस्पृह: निस्पृह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Content, unenvious. f. (-हा) 1 A plant, (Gloriosa superba.) 2 Contentment. E. नि neg. स्पृहा desire.
निस्यन्द: निस्यन्द m. (-न्दः) Trickling, oozing, issuing. E. नि before स्यन्द to ooze, aff. अच्.
निस्राव: निस्राव m. (-वः) The scum of boiled rice. E. नि before स्रु to ooze or drop, aff. घञ्.
निस्वन: निस्वन m. (-नः) 1 Sound. 2 Silence. E. नि before स्वन to sound, aff. अप्.
निस्वान: निस्वान m. (-नः) Sound. E. नि before स्वन with घञ् aff.: see the last.
निहत: निहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Killed, slain. E. नि affir. हत killing.
निहनन: निहनन n. (-नं) Killing, slaughter. E. नि before हनन killed.
निहन्तृ: निहन्तृ mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ) Murderous, who or what kills. E. नि before हन to kill, तृच् aff.
निहन्यमान: निहन्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Killed. E. नि, हन to kill, pass. v. शानच् aff.
निहव: निहव m. (-वः) Calling, calling to. E. नि before ह्वे to call, अप् aff.
निहाका: निहाका f. (-का) An iguana or the Gangetic alligator. E. नि before हा to quit, Uṇādi aff. कन्.
निहार: निहार m. (-रः) Frost, dew: see नीहार.
निहिंसन: निहिंसन n. (-नं) Killing, slaughter. E. नि before हिंस to kill or hurt, aff. ल्युट्.
निहित: निहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Deposited, delivered, given, entrusted. 2 Applied to, bestowed upon. 3 Laid, (as dust by rain.) E. नि before घा to have, aff. क्त.
निहीन: निहीन m. (-नः) A low man, an outcast. E. नि before हीन abandoned.
निह्नव: निह्नव m. (-वः) 1 Denial or concealment of knowledge, dissimulation, secrecy. 2 Concealment in general. 3 Mistrust, doubt, suspicion. 4 Wickedness. 5 A secret. E. नि before ह्नु to hide or secrete, aff. अच्.
निह्नववादिन्: निह्नववादिन् m. (-दी) A defendant or witness who prevaricates or tries to hide the truth. E. निह्नव, and वादिन who speaks.
निह्नवोत्तर: निह्नवोत्तर n. (-रं) An evasive reply or defence. E. निह्नव, and उत्तर answer.
निह्नुत: निह्नुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Concealed, secreted. 2 Denied, evaded. E. नि before ह्नु to secrete, aff. क्त.
निह्नुति: निह्नुति f. (-तिः) 1 Denial or concealment of knowledge, dissimulation, reserve, secrecy. 2 Hiding, concealment. E. नि before ह्नु to secrete, aff. क्तिन्.
निह्नुवान: निह्नुवान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Insinuating, using double entendre. E. नि, ह्नु to secrete, शानच् aff.
निह्राद: निह्राद m. (-दः) Sound. E. नि before ह्रद to sound, aff. घञ्.
निह्रादवत्: निह्रादवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Sounding, making a noise. E. निह्राद, and मतुप् aff.
नीक: नीक m. (-कः) The name of a tree. E. णी to gain, Uṇādi aff. कन्.
नीकार: नीकार m. (-रः) Disrespect, contempt, vilifying, degrading. E. नि before कृ to make, aff. अण्.
नीकाश: नीकाश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) (In composition,) Like, resembling. m. (-शः) Certainty, ascertainment. E. नि before काश to shine, aff. घञ्, and the vowel made long.
नीच: नीच mfn. (-चः-चा-चं) 1 Low, (in stature,) short, dwarfish. 2 Low, (in condition,) vile, base, mean. 3 Deep. E. न privative, ई good fortune, चि to obtain, aff. ड.
नीचक: नीचक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Low, dwarfish, a dwarf. 2 Vile, low. f. (-का) An excellent cow. E. कन added to the preceding.
नीचकिन्: नीचकिन् m. (-की) 1 The head or top of any thing. 2 The owner of a good cow.
नीचकैस्: नीचकैस् ind. Low, below, little, vile, &c. E. नीचैस् low, अकच् inserted.
नीचग: नीचग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Low, vile, base. n. (-गं) Water. f. (-गा) A river. E. नीच low or deep, and ग who is going.
नीचभोज्य: नीचभोज्य m. (-ज्यः) An onion. E. नीच a low man, and भोज्य food.
नीचिका: नीचिका f. (-का) A good cow; also नीचिकी and नैचिकी.
नीचैस्: नीचैस् ind. Little, small, low. E. नि before चि to collect, डैसि aff. and the vowel of नि made long.
नीड: नीड mn. (-डः-डं) 1 A nest. 2 A place, a spot. E. नि before इङ् to go, aff. घञ्.
नीडज: नीडज m. (-जः) A bird in general. E. नीड a nest, and ज born.
नीडोद्भव: नीडोद्भव m. (-वः) A bird. E. नीड a nest, and उद्भव born.
नीत: नीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Well behaved, correct, modest. 2 Gained, obtained. 3 Led, conducted. n. (-तं) 1 Wealth. 2 Corn, grain. E. णी to get, &c. aff. क्त.
नीति: नीति f. (-ती) 1 Guiding, directing. 2 Obtaining, acquirement, acquisition. 3 Polity, political science, treating especially of the administration of government, including the practice of morality in private life, both by the sovereign and his subjects. E. णी to guide or gain, aff. क्तिन्.
नीतिकथा: नीतिकथा f. (-था) Any work on polity, or good government. E. नीति, and कथा a tale.
नीतिकुशल: नीतिकुशल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Politic, conversant with government and human affairs. E. नीति, and कुशल able.
नीतिघोष: नीतिघोष m. (-षः) The car of VṚHASPATI. E. नीनि guiding, and घोष sound.
नीतिज्ञ: नीतिज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Knowing what is right, especially in government, sagacious, politic. (-ज्ञः) A statesman, a politician. E. नीति, and ज्ञ who knows.
नीतिमत्: नीतिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Moral, eminent for royal duties. E. नीति, and मतुप् aff.
नीतिविद्या: नीतिविद्या f. (-द्या) Political science. E. नीति, and विद्या knowledge.
नीतिशास्त्र: नीतिशास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) The science of political ethics, or any work treating of it. E. नीति, and शास्त्र a scripture.
नीत्त: नीत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Given, given away. E. नि before, दत्त given, form irr.
नीत्वा: नीत्वा ind. 1 Having taken. 2 Having passed or spent. E. णी to take, क्त्वा aff.
नीथ: नीथ m. (-थः) A guider, a leader. n. (-थं) Water. E. णी to guide, कथन् Uṇādi aff.
नीध्र: नीध्र n. (-ध्रं) 1 The edge of a thatch. 2 A wood. 3 The circumference of a wheel. 4 The moon. 5 The constellation Revatī. E. नि before धृ to fall, &c. aff. क, and the vowel of the prefix made long: this is considered as a various reading also of नीब्र, q. v.
नीप: नीप m. (-पः) 1 The Kadamba tree, (Nauclea kadamba.) 2 A species of Ixora, (I. bandhuca, Rox.) 3 A sort of Aśoca or Nil Asoka. E. णी to obtain, (pleasure,) and प Uṇādi aff.
नीयमान: नीयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Being sought or obtained. 2 Being led or conducted. 3 Being taken or taken away. E. नी to obtain, शानच् aff. यक् inserted.
नीर: नीर n. (-रं) 1 Water. 2 Juice, liquor. E. नी to obtain, aff. रक्.
नीरक्त: नीरक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्त) Colourless, faded, having the colour taken out. E. निर् neg. रक्त red or dyed.
नीरज: नीरज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Aquatick. n. (-जः) 1 A sort of Costus, (C. speciosus.) 2 A lotus in general. m. (-जः) An otter. E. नीर water, and ज born, or produced.
नीरजस्: नीरजस् mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः) 1 Free from dust. 2 Having no pollen, (as a flower.) f. (-जाः) A woman not menstruating. E. निर् neg. रजस् dust, &c. and इ made long before र.
नीरजस्व: नीरजस्व mfn. (-स्वः-स्वा-स्वं) Free from dust. E. निर्, and रजस् dust, the इ made long by the dropping of the र.
नीरजीकारित: नीरजीकारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cleansed, made free from dust. E. नीरजस्, and कारित caused, च्चि augment.
नीरत: नीरत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Indifferent, not taking pleasure in. 2 Stopped, staying. E. नि neg. रत engaged in, इ made long.
नीरद: नीरद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Toothless. m. (-दः) A cloud. E. नीर water, द what gives, or नि neg. रद a tooth.
नीरदिन्: नीरदिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Cloudy. E. नीरद, and इनि aff.
नीरधि: नीरधि m. (-धिः) The ocean. E. नीर water, and धि having.
नीरनिधि: नीरनिधि m. (-धिः) The ocean. E. नीर water, and निधि receptacle.
नीरन्ध्र: नीरन्ध्र mfn. (-न्ध्रः-न्ध्रा-न्ध्रं) 1 Coarse, thick, gross, without interstices. 2 Entire, having no holes. 3 Imperforate. E. नी for निर् negative prefix, रन्ध्र a hole.
नीरस: नीरस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Dry, withered, insipid, devoid of taste, &c. morally or physically. m. (-सः) The pomegranate. E. नी for निर् negative or affirmative prefix, and रस juice, flavour.
नीराखु: नीराखु m. (-खुः) An otter. E. नीर water, and आखु a cat; the water-cat.
नीराजन: नीराजन nf. (-नं-ना) 1 Lustration of arms; a military and religious ceremony held on the 19th of Aśvin, and by kings or generals before taking the field; it is still observed by some Hindū states, under the name of Desahara. 2 Waving lights before an idol; but it may also be performed with a lotus, clean cloth, or the leaves of various sacred plants; prostration is also considered as the fifth kind of this sort of adoration. E. निर् completely, राज to shine, aff. युच्; or नीर water, and अजन going, sprinkling the arms, horses, &c. with water.
नीरिन्दु: नीरिन्दु m. (-न्दुः) A plant, (Trophis aspera.) E. नीर water, इन्दु the moon.
नीरुच्: नीरुच् mfn. (-रुक्) Dull, dim, faded. E. निर् neg. रुच् light, and इ made long.
नीरुज्: नीरुज् mfn. (-रुक्) Convalescent, well in health. E. नि privative, रुज disease.
नीरुज: नीरुज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Convalescent, well. n. (-जं) A sort of Costus, (C. speciosus.) E. नि implying opposition, (anti,) and रुज् disease.
नीरुप: नीरुप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Formless, shapeless. n. (-पं) Heaven, æther. m. (-पः) 1 Air, wind. 2 GOD. E. निर् neg. रुप form.
नील: नील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Blue, dark blue or black. m. (-लः) 1 Black or dark blue, (the colour.) 2 The blue mountain, one of the principal ranges of mountains, dividing the world into nine portions, and lying immediately north of Hāvrata or the central division. 3 One of the monkey chiefs. 4 One of the Nidhis or divine treasures of KUVERA. 5 A gem, (the sapphire.) 6 A  name of the Buddha MAÑJUGHOṢA. 7 The blue or hill Maina, a bird so called. n. (-लं) 1 Indigo, the dye. 2 A mark, a characteristick mark. 3 A medical plant, apparently distinct form the Indigofera. 4 Blue vitriol. 5 Black salt. 6 Poison. 7 Antimony. f. (-ला) 1 A blue fly. 2 A Rāgiṇī or mode of music, personified as the wife of the Rāga Mallāra. f. (ली) 1 The indigo plant, (Indigofera tinctoria.) 2 A complaint of the eyes, a darkening of the pupil. 3 A bruise, a black and blue mark on the skin. E. नील to dye or tinge, क aff. or नीली indigo, अन् aff., implying being coloured or stained by it.
नीलक: नीलक m. (-कः) 1 The Nil Gao or slate coloured antilope, (A. picta.) 2 A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa.) n. (-कं) 1 Blue steel. 2 Blue vitriol. 3 Black salt. E. कन् added to the preceding.
नीलकण्ठ: नीलकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A gallinule. 3 A sparrow. 4 A wagtail. 5 A peacock. 6 Morunga, (Hyperanthera morunga.) 7 A blue jay. E. नील blue or black, and कण्ठ the throat; also कालकण्ठ.
नीलकण्ठाक्ष: नीलकण्ठाक्ष n. (-क्षं) The Eloeocarpus seed. E. नीलकण्ठ ŚIVA, and अक्ष seed.
नीलकमल: नीलकमल n. (-लं) The blue lotus. E. नील, and कमल a lotus.
नीलकुरुण्टक: नीलकुरुण्टक m. (-कः) Blue Barleria, (B. cærulea.) E. नील, and कुरुण्टक Barleria.
नीलक्रौञ्च: नीलक्रौञ्च m. (-ञ्चः) A sort of curlew or heron. E. नील blue, and क्रौञ्च a heron, &c.
नीलग्रीव: नीलग्रीव m. (-वः) A name of MAHĀDEVA. E. नील blue, and ग्रीवा neck; the neck of ŚIVA was stained blue by the acrimony of the poison, which, upon its production at the churning of the ocean, he swallowed.
नीलङ्गु: नीलङ्गु m. (-ङ्गुः) 1 An insect in general. 2 A sort of worm. 3 A Shakal. E. नि before लगि to go, Uṇādi aff. कु, and the इ of नि made long.
नीलज: नीलज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced in the blue mountain, &c. n. (-जं) Blue steel. E. नील, and ज produced.
नीलझिण्टी: नीलझिण्टी f. (-ण्टी) Blue Barleria. E. नील blue, and भिण्टी Barleria.
नीलपङ्क: नीलपङ्क n. (-ङ्कं) 1 Darkness. 2 Black mud. E. नील black, and पङ्क clay or mire.
नीलपटल: नीलपटल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Very dark or black. E. नील, and पटल abundance.
नीलपत्र: नीलपत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Having black or dark blue leaves. n. (-त्रं) The blue lotus. E. नील blue, and पत्र leaf.
नीलपाचन: नीलपाचन n. (-नं) Steeping or maceration of indigo. E. नील, and पाचन cooking.
नीलपाचनभाण्ड: नीलपाचनभाण्ड n. (-ण्डं) An indigo vat. E. नीलपाचन, and भाण्ड vessel.
नीलपद्म: नीलपद्म n. (-द्मं) The blue lotus, (Nymphæa cærulea.) E. नील, and पद्म a lotus.
नीलपिच्छ: नीलपिच्छ m. (-च्छः) A falcon. E. नील blue, and पिच्छ a tail.
नीलपुष्प: नीलपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A sort of Verbesina with blue flowers. f. (-ष्पी) A blue species of Rasan. E. नील blue, and पुष्प flower.
नीलपुष्पिका: नीलपुष्पिका f. (-का) The indigo plant. E. कन् added to नीलपुष्पी.
नीलपृष्ठ: नीलपृष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A sort of fish, commonly called Rohi, (Cyprinus denticulatus.) E. नील blue, पृष्ठ the back.
नीलभ: नीलभ m. (-भः) 1 The moon. 2 A cloud. 3 A bee. E. नील blue or black, भा to shine, to show, aff. क.
नीलमणि: नीलमणि m. (-णिः) A gem of a blue colour, the sapphire. E. नील blue, and मणि a jewel.
नीलमाधव: नीलमाधव m. (-वः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. नील, and माधव VIṢṆU, being of a dark colour.
नीलमीलिक: नीलमीलिक m. (-कः) A firefly. E. नील black or dark blue, मील to twinkle, aff. टक्.
नीलमृत्तिका: नीलमृत्तिका f. (-का) 1 Iron pyrites. 2 Black mould. E. नील, and मृत्तिका earth.
नीललोह: नीललोह n. (-हं) Blue steel. E. नील blue, and लोह iron.
नीललोहित: नीललोहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Purple, of a purple colour. m. (-तः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A mixture of red and blue, purple. f. (-त्ता) A vegetable: see भूमिजम्बु. E. नील blue or black, and लोहित red.
नीलवर्ण: नीलवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं) Blue, of a blue colour. E. नील, and वर्ण colour.
नीलवसन: नीलवसन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Wearing dark blue or black garments. m. (-नः) The planet Saturn. E. नील dark blue, and वसन vesture.
नीलवस्त्र: नीलवस्त्र mfn. (-स्त्रः-स्त्रा-स्त्रं) Dressed in dark blue or black vesture. n. (-स्त्रं) Dark coloured cloth. m. (-स्त्रः) A name of BALARĀMA. E. नील, and वस्त्र clothes.
नीलवासस्: नीलवासस् mfn. (-साः-साः-सः) Dressed in dark blue clothes. m. (-साः) A name of Saturn. E. नील dark blue, वासस् raiment.
नीलवृष: नीलवृष m. (-षः) A dark coloured bull. E. नील, and वृष a bull.
नीलाक्ष: नीलाक्ष m. (-क्षः) A goose. E. नील, and अक्ष an eye, having dark blue eyes.
नीलाङ्ग: नीलाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 The Indian crane. 2 The blue jay. E. नील blue, and अङ्ग body.
नीलाङ्गु: नीलाङ्गु m. (-ङ्गुः) 1 An insect in general. 2 A sort of insect. 3 A Shakāl. f. (-ङ्गुः) A gad-fly. E. see नीलङ्गु the penultimate being irregularly made long.
नीलाञ्जन: नीलाञ्जन n. (-नं) Blue vitriol. f. (-ना) Lightning. E. नील blue, अञ्जन collyrium, &c.
नीलाञ्जसा: नीलाञ्जसा f. (-सा) 1 One of the Apsarasas or courtezans of Svarga. 2 The name of a river. 3 Lightning. E. नील dark, अञ्जस quickly, affs. अच् and टाप्.
नीलाम्बर: नीलाम्बर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Dressed in dark blue cloth. m. (-रः) 1 A name of BALARĀMA. 2 A demon, a goblin. 3 A name of ŚANI or Saturn. n. (-रं) Black or dark blue rainment. E. नील, and अम्बर clothing, &c.
नीलाम्बुजन्मन्: नीलाम्बुजन्मन् n. (-न्म) The blue lotus. E. नील, and अम्बुजन्मन् a lotus.
नीलाभ: नीलाभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Blue. m. (-भः) A cloud. E. नील, and आभ what shines.
नीलाभ्र: नीलाभ्र m. (-भ्रः) A dark cloud. E. नील, and अभ्र cloud.
नीलाश्मन्: नीलाश्मन् m. (-श्मा) A blue stone, a sapphire. E. नील, and अश्मन् a stone.
नीलिका: नीलिका f. (-का) 1 A plant, (Nyctanthes tristis;) a species with blue flowers. 2 The indigo plant. 3 A slight malady; black and blue marks on the body from bruises, &c. E. कन् added to नीली.
नीलिनी: नीलिनी f. (-नी) 1 Indigo, (Indigofera tinctoria.) 2 A black species of Tëori. E. नील black or dark blue, poss. aff. इनि fem. aff. ङीप्.
नीलीराग: नीलीराग m. (-गः) 1 A firm and constant friend. 2 Firm, unalterable attachment, (as that of RĀMA and SĪTĀ.) 3 Dark blue. E. नीली indigo, and राग colour; as permanent as the dye of indigo.
नीलीसन्धान: नीलीसन्धान n. (-नं) Fermentation or maceration of indigo. E. नीली, and सन्धान fermentation.
नीलीसन्धानभाण्ड: नीलीसन्धानभाण्ड n. (-ण्डं) An indigo vat. E. नीलीसन्धान, and भाण्ड vessel.
नीलोत्पल: नीलोत्पल n. (-लं) A blue lotus, (Nymphæa cærulea.) E. नील blue, and उत्पल a lotus.
नीलोत्पलिन्: नीलोत्पलिन् m. (-ली) One of the Jaina saints or teachers.
नीलोपल: नीलोपल n. (-लं) A blue stone, lapis lazuli. E. नील, and उपल a stone.
नीवर: नीवर m. (-रः) 1 Trade, traffick. 2 A place, &c. proper for the site of a habitation. 3 A religious mendicant. n. (-रं) 1 Water. 2 Mud. E. णी to obtain, &c. ष्वरच् Uṇādi aff.
नीवाक: नीवाक m. (-कः) Dearth, scarcity. E. नि before वच to speak, aff. घञ्; creating alarm and causing conversation.
नीवार: नीवार m. (-रः) Rice growing wild or without cultivation. E. नि before वृ to be, aff. घञ्.
नीवि: नीवि f. (-विः-वी) 1 Capital, principal, stock. 2 Stake, wager. 3 A cloth round a woman's waist, or the ends of the cloth passed round the loins so as to hold the whole together; on being loosed the lower members are exposed: the tie of drawers worn by women, &c. 4 The outer tie of a packet, in which the offerings of a Śūdra at funeral obsequies are presented. E. नि before व्येञ् to cover, Uṇādi aff. इन् and ङीष् optionally added; the इ of नि is made long, and the radical finals rejected.
नीवृत्: नीवृत् mfn. (-वृत्) Any inhabited country. E. नि always, वृत to be, aff. क्विप्, and the vowel of the prefix made long.
नीव्र: नीव्र n. (-व्रं) 1 The edge of a thatch. 2 The circumference of a wheel. 3 A wood. 4 The moon. 5 The constellation Revatī. E. नि certainly, वृ to be, aff. क, deriv. irr.; also नीध्र.
नीशार: नीशार m. (-रः) 1 A warm cloth, a blanket. 2 Curtains, musquito curtains. 3 An outer tent or screen. नि before शृ to hurt, &c. aff. घञ्, deriv. irr.
नीहार: नीहार m. (-रः) 1 Frost, hoar frost. 2 Heavy dew. E. नि before हृ to steal or take, aff. घञ्.
नु: नु ind. 1 A particle, of interrogation; 2 Of discrimination; 3 of reflexion. 4 Of doubt; 5 Of contempt; 6 Of pretence; 7 Of respect. 8 A particle implying cause or motive: (what, but, how, hum, or, either, &c. will in general express it.) E. नुद to go, or नु praise, &c. aff. डु.
नु m. (-नुः) 1 A weapon. 2 Time. 3 A boat. 4 The nasal mark above the line in neuter nouns, &c. f. (नुः) Praise, eulogium, panegyrick. E. ण्णु to praise, &c. aff. क्विप्.
नुड: नुड r. 6th cl. (नुडति) To hurt or kill.
नुत: नुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Praised, commended. E. णु to praise, aff. क्त.
नुति: नुति f. (-तिः) 1 Praise, eulogium, panegyrick. 2 Worship, reverence. E. णु to praise, क्तिन् aff.
नुत्त: नुत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Sent, ordered, despatched. m. (-त्तः) A plant: see लकुच. E. णुद to send, aff. क्त; also नुन्न.
नुनुत्सु: नुनुत्सु mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु) Desirous of removing. E. णुद to send, desid. v. उ aff.
नुन्न: नुन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Sent, thrown, despatched, cast, dismissed. E. णुद to send, aff. क्त, form irr.; also नुत्त.
नूत: नूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 New. 2 Praised, eulogized, hymned. E. णु to praise, aff. क्त.
नूतन: नूतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) New, recent, fresh, young, &c. E. नव new, नू substituted for it, and तनप् aff.
नूतनत्व: नूतनत्व n. (-त्वं) Newness, novelty. E. त्व added to the last; also with तल्, नूतनता.
नूत्न: नूत्न mfn. (-त्नः-त्ना-त्नं) New. E. नू substituted for नव new, त्नप् aff.
नूद: नूद m. (-दः) The mulberry tree, (Morus Indica.) E. णुद to send, क aff. and the deriv. irr.
नूनम्: नूनम् ind. 1 Certainly, assuredly. 2 A particle of doubt or deliberation. 3 A reminiscent particle. 4 An expletive. E. नू a particle, नम to bow or bend, aff. विच्, deriv. irr.
नूपुर: नूपुर mn. (-रः-रं) An ornament for the toes and feet. E. णु to praise or be praised. aff. क्विप्, नू an ornament, पुर to precede, aff. क.
नृ: नृ r. 1st cl. (नरति) 5th cl. (नृणाति) To lead, to conduct, to guide, physically or morally.
नृ m. (ना) 1 Man, individually or collectively, a man, mankind. 2 A piece at chess, &c. 3 A gnomon. E. णी to guide or gain, aff. डृन्.
नृकेशरिन्: नृकेशरिन् m. (-री) The Nṛsiṃha or man-lion Avatar. E. नृ, and केशरिन् a lion.
नृग: नृग m. (-गः) The name of a king, the son of IKṢVĀKU.
नृचक्षस्: नृचक्षस् m. (-क्षाः) A demon, a Rākṣasa, a goblin. E. नृ a man, and चक्षस् an eater; from चक्ष to eat, असुन् aff.
नृजग्ध: नृजग्ध m. (-ग्धः) A man eater, a cannibal, a Rākṣasa. E. (by whom,) नृ man, जग्ध is eaten.
नृत: नृत (ई) नृती r. 4th cl. (नृत्यति) To dance, to dance as an actor, to gesticulate, to act.
नृति: नृति f. (-तिः) Dancing, the science or practice. E. नृत to dance, aff. कि.
नृतू: नृतू m. (-तूः) 1 A dancer, a mime, an actor. 2 Earth. 3 A worm. 4 Length. E. नृत to dance, and कू aff.
नृत्त: नृत्त n. (-त्तं) Dancing. E. नृत to dance, aff. क्त.
नृत्य: नृत्य n. (-त्यं) Dancing, acting, the actor's practice in general. E. नृत to dance, aff. क्यप्.
नृत्यत्: नृत्यत् mfn. (-त्यन्-त्यन्ती-त्यत्) Dancing. E. नृत to dance, शतृ aff.
नृदेव: नृदेव m. (-बः) A king. E. नृ, and देव a divinity.
नृधर्मन्: नृधर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Acting as a man, doing a man's duty, &c. m. (-र्म्मा) A name of KUVERA. n. (-र्म्म) Manly property or duty. E. नृ man, धर्म्म virtue, अनिच aff.
नृधर्म्मन्: नृधर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Acting as a man, doing a man's duty, &c. m. (-र्म्मा) A name of KUVERA. n. (-र्म्म) Manly property or duty. E. नृ man, धर्म्म virtue, अनिच aff.
नृप: नृप m. (-पः) A king, a sovereign. E. नृ man, पा to protect, aff. ड.
नृपनीति: नृपनीति f. (-तिः) Royal policy. E. नृप, नीति policy.
नृपति: नृपति m. (-तिः) 1 A name of KUVERA. 2 A king, a sovereign. E. नृ man, and पति a master.
नृपद्रुम: नृपद्रुम m. (-मः) A tree, (Cassia fistula.) E. नृप, and द्रम a tree.
नृपप्रिय: नृपप्रिय m. (-यः) A thorny species of bambu, (Bambusa spinosa.) E. नृप a king, and प्रिय fond of.
नृपमन्दिर: नृपमन्दिर n. (-रं) A royal palace. E. नृप a king, and मन्दिर a residence.
नृपमान: नृपमान m. (-नः) Sound of musick, made to give warning to kings when eating or feasting. E. नृप, and मान measure.
नृपलक्ष्मन्: नृपलक्ष्मन् n. (-क्ष्म) 1 The royal umbrella. 2 Any of the royal insignia. E. नृप a king, and लक्ष्मन् a mark or sign.
नृपलिङ्ग: नृपलिङ्ग n. (ङ्गं) Any emblem or mark of royalty. E. नृप, and लिङ्ग mark.
नृपलिङ्गधर: नृपलिङ्गधर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Assuming the insignia of sovereignty. 2 Taking, (fraudulently,) the emblem or marks of the royal or military caste. E. नृपलिङ्ग, and धर who has.
नृपवल्लभ: नृपवल्लभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) A king's friend. f. (-भा) A queen. E. नृप, and वल्लभ beloved.
नृपसंश्रय: नृपसंश्रय m. (-यः) Service of princes. E. नृप, and संश्रय dependance.
नृपसभ: नृपसभ n. (-भं) 1 An assembly of princes. 2 A palace. E. नृप a king, and सभा an assembly.
नृपांश: नृपांश m. (-शः) Revenue, the royal portion; of grain, a sixth, eight, or twelfth; of fruits, &c. a sixth; and of merchandise a fiftieth. E. नृप, and अंश a part.
नृपात्मज: नृपात्मज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Of royal birth. m. (-जः) A prince. f. (-जा) 1 A bitter gourd. 2 A princess. E. नृप a king, and आत्मज offspring.
नृपाध्वर: नृपाध्वर m. (-रः) A sort of sacrifice; the Rājasūya, held by a lord paramount, in which all the offices are performed by tributary princes. E. नृप a king, अध्वर a sacrifice.
नृपाभीर: नृपाभीर n. (-रं) Music played at the royal meals.
नृपामय: नृपामय m. (-यः) Consumption. E. नृप, and आमय disease.
नृपावर्त: नृपावर्त्त n. (-र्त्तं) A kind of gem. E. नृप, and आवर्त्त what revolves.
नृपावर्त्त: नृपावर्त्त n. (-र्त्तं) A kind of gem. E. नृप, and आवर्त्त what revolves.
नृपासन: नृपासन n. (-नं) A throne. E. नृप a king, and आसन a seat.
नृपोचित: नृपोचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Kingly, princely, suited to a king. E. नृप, and उचित proper.
नृयज्ञ: नृयज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) Hospitality. E. नृ a man, and यज्ञ sacrifice.
नृवराह: नृवराह m. (-हः) The boar incarnation of VIṢṆU. E. नृ a man, वराह a boar; being delineated with the figure of a man, and the head of the wild boar.
नृशंस: नृशंस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Malicious, wicked, hurtful, injurious, mischievous, destructive. E. नृ man, शसि to hurt, aff. अण्.
नृशंसवृत्त: नृशंसवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Practising mischief. E. नृशंश, add वृत्त engaged in.
नृसिंह: नृसिंह m. (-हः) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 The fourth Avatāra or descent of that deity, in the shape of a man, with the head and claws of a lion. 3 A chief, a noble, a great or illustrious man. E. नृ a man, and सिंह a lion; applied in composition, also to signify pre-eminence.
नृसेन: नृसेन nf. (-नं-ना) An army of men. E. नृ a man, and सेना an army.
नृसोम: नृसोम m. (-मः) An illustrious or great man, a prince or chief. E. नृ mankind, and सोम the moon, here implying superiority or excellence.
नृहरि: नृहरि m. (-रिः) VIṢṆU as the man-lion. E. नृ, and हरि a lion.
नेजक: नेजक m. (-कः) A washerman. E. णिज to cleanse, aff. वुन्.
नेतव्य: नेतव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be taken, to be carried or conducted. E. णी to take, तव्य aff.
नेतृ: नेतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Leading, conducting, one who guides or leads, &c. m. (-ता) 1 A master, an owner. 2 A guide. E. णी to lead, aff. तृच्.
नेत्र: नेत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं) A leader, a guide, one who guides or leads. n. (-त्रं) 1 The eye. 2 The root of a tree. 3 Bleached or wove silk. 4 A car, a carriage. 5 The string of a churning rope. 6 An enema pipe. mn. (-त्रः-त्रं) Any tubular vessel. f. (-त्री) 1 A river. 2 The goddess LAKṢMĪ. E. णी to guide or gain, Uṇādi aff. ष्ट्रन्, fem. aff. ङीष्.
नेत्रज: नेत्रज n. (-जं) A tear. E. नेत्र, and ज born.
नेत्रच्छद: नेत्रच्छद m. (-दः) An eyelid. E. नेत्र the eye, छद to cover, aff. अच्.
नेत्रपर्यन्त: नेत्रपर्य्यन्त mfn. (न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) As far as to the eye, up to the eye. m. (-न्तः) The outer angle of the eye. E. नेत्र, and पर्य्यन्त limitative.
नेत्रपर्य्यन्त: नेत्रपर्य्यन्त mfn. (न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) As far as to the eye, up to the eye. m. (-न्तः) The outer angle of the eye. E. नेत्र, and पर्य्यन्त limitative.
नेत्रपिण्ड: नेत्रपिण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 A cat. 2 The ball of the eye. E. नेत्र the eye, and पिण्ड a ball of flesh, &c.
नेत्रयोनि: नेत्रयोनि m. (-निः) 1 INDRA. 2 The moon. E. नेत्र an eye, and योनि the vulva; being covered with marks resembling that organ, through the curse of GAUTAMA, whose wife he had attempted to debauch; the sage afterwards relenting, changed these disgraceful marks on the body of the deity to as many eyes.
नेत्ररञ्जन: नेत्ररञ्जन n. (-नं) Collyrium. E. नेत्र, and रञ्जन delighting.
नेत्ररोग: नेत्ररोग m. (-गः) Any disease of the eye. E. नेच, and रोग disease.
नेत्रवस्त्र: नेत्रवस्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) A veil over the eye. E. नेत्र, and वस्त्र clothes.
नेत्रामय: नेत्रामय m. (-यः) Ophthalmia, &c. E. नेत्र, and आमय sickness.
नेत्राम्बु: नेत्राम्बु m. (-म्बुः) A tear. E. नेत्र an eye, and अम्बु water.
नेत्रोत्सव: नेत्रोत्सव n. (-वं) Any pleasing or beautiful object. E. नेत्र, and उत्सव festival.
नेत्रौषध: नेत्रौषध n. (-धं) 1 Green sulphate of iron considered as a collyrium. 2 Collyrium in general. f. (-धी) A drug, commonly क्ॐगा. E. नेत्र the eye, and औषध a medicament.
नेदयत्: नेदयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Approximating, bringing near. E. नेद for अन्तिक nom. verb, शतृ aff.
नेदिष्ठ: नेदिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) 1 Very near. 2 Clever. m. (-ष्ठः) A tree, (Alangium hexapetalum.) E. अन्तिक near, इष्ठन् affix of the superlative, and the form irr.; also नेदीयस् with ईयसुन् aff.
नेदीयस्: नेदीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Very near, nearest: see the last.
नेन्य: नेन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Taking or obtaining frequently. E. णी to obtain, frequent. v., अच् aff.
नेप: नेप m. (-पः) 1 The family priest. 2 Water. E. णी to guide, Uṇādi aff. प.
नेपथ्य: नेपथ्य n. (-थ्यं) 1 A stage, or the part behind the scenes, the tiring room, &c. 2 Ornament, embellishment. E. णी to guide, विच् aff. and the vowel changed; ने the eye, or a chief, पथ्य proper, agreeable, grateful.
नेपाल: नेपाल n. (-लः) The country of Nepal. E. ने a chief: see the last, and पाल cherishing.
नेपालिका: नेपालिका f. (-का) Arsenic. E. नेपाल, and कन् aff.
नेम: नेम m. (-मः) 1 Time, period, season. 2 Term, boundary, limit. 3 Part, portion. 4 A fence, a boundary wall or hedge. 5 A  hole, a chasm. 6 Fraud, deceit. 7 Acting, dancing. 8 Other, different. 9 Evening. 10 Up, above. 11 A root. E. णी to gain, Uṇādi aff. मन्.
नेमि: नेमि f. (-मिः-मी) 1 The circumference of a wheel. 2 The framework for the rope of a well. m. (-मिः) 1 The twenty-second Jina or Jaina pontiff. 2 A sacred place, as Mathura. mf. (-मिः-मी) A tree, (Dalbergia Oujeiniensis). E. णी to gain or go, Uṇādi aff. मि.
नेमिचक्र: नेमिचक्र m. (-क्रः) A prince descended from PARĪKṢIT, who is said to have removed the capital of India to Kauśāmbī, after the inundation of Hastinapur.
नेमिन्: नेमिन् m. (-मी) A tree. E. नेमि the circumference of a wheel, इनि aff.; the wood being used for its manufacture.
नेष्टृ: नेष्टृ m. (-ष्टा) One of the officiating priests at a sacrifice. E. णी to lead or conduct the ceremonies, Uṇādi aff. तृच् and षुक augment.
नैःश्रेयस: नैःश्रेयस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Relating to final emancipation, leading to it, effecting it, &c. E. निःश्रेयस, and अण् aff.
नैःश्रेयसिक: नैःश्रेयसिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to final emancipation, &c. E. निःश्रेयस, and ठक् aff.
नैःस्नेह्य: नैःस्नेह्य n. (-ह्यं) 1 Dryness, austerity. 2 Coldness, want of feeling or affection. E. निःस्नेह, and ष्यञ् aff.
नैक: नैक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Many, various. E. न neg. एक one.
नैकटिक: नैकटिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Near, being near. E. निकट, and ठञ् aff.
नैकट्य: नैकट्य n. (-ट्यं) Proximity, vicinage. E. निकट, and ष्यञ् aff.
नैकभेद: नैकभेद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Various, multiform, manifold. E. नैक, and भेद kind.
नैकरूप: नैकरूप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Multiform. E. नैक, and रूप form.
नैकषेय: नैकषेय m. (-यः) A Rākṣasa, a fiend, a goblin. E. निकषा the mother of the race, and ढक् aff.
नैकृतिक: नैकृतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Morose, harsh spoken. 2 Wicked, bad. E. निकृति, and ठक् aff.
नैगम: नैगम m. (-मः) 1 An Upaniṣad or portion of the Vedas. 2 A sectarian, not a heretic. 2 A trader, a merchant. 4 A citizen, a townsman. 5 Guiding, leading, directing. 6 A road, a way. E. निगम a religious obligation, aff. अण्.
नैचिक: नैचिक n. (-कं) The head of an ox. f. (-की) A capital cow. E. नीचैस् low, down, चर to go, ठक् aff. and the radical finals rejected; also नीचिकी, &c.
नैज: नैज mfn. (-जः-जी-जं) Own. E. निज, and अण् aff.
नैत्य: नैत्य n. (-त्यं) Eternity, perpetuity. E. नित्य, and अण् aff.
नैत्यक: नैत्यक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Always, constant, indispensable. E. नित्य, and वुञ् aff.
नैत्यिक: नैत्यिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Invariable, constant, perpetual, indispensable. E. नित्य, and ठक् aff.
नैद्र: नैद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्री-द्रं) Sleepy, somniferous, relating or occurring in sleep. E. निद्रा, and अण् aff.
नैधान: नैधान mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Relating to a treasure, a nest, &c. f. (-नी) A boundary where some articles are buried and dug up. E. निधान a treasure, अण् aff.
नैपाल: नैपाल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Produced in Nepal. f. (-ली) 1 Double jasmine. 2 Red arsenick. 3 Śephālikā, (Nyctanthes tristis.) 4 Indigo. E. नेपाल Nepal, अण् and ङीप् affs.; brought from thence.
नैपालिक: नैपालिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Produced in or brought from Nepal, &c. n. (-कं) Copper. E. नेपाल, and ठक् aff.
नैपुण: नैपुण n. (-णं) Dexterity, cleverness, skill. E. निपुण skilful, aff. अण्; also with ष्यञ् aff., नैपुण्य n. (-ण्यं.)
नैमित्तिक: नैमित्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Occasional. n. (-कं) Occasional, periodical act or rite. E. निमित्त cause, ठक् aff.
नैमित्तिककर्मन्: नैमित्तिककर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) An occasional ceremony, such as should be observed on the birth of a child, &c. E. नैमित्तिक, and कर्म्भ act; also नैमित्तिकक्रिया, &c.
नैमित्तिककर्म्मन्: नैमित्तिककर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) An occasional ceremony, such as should be observed on the birth of a child, &c. E. नैमित्तिक, and कर्म्भ act; also नैमित्तिकक्रिया, &c.
नैमिष: नैमिष mfn. (-षः-षी-षं) Momentary, transient, in a twinkling. n. (-षं) The name of a forest. see नैमिषारण्य. E. निमिष, and अण् aff.
नैमिषारण्य: नैमिषारण्य n. (-ण्यं) A wood celebrated as the residence of the Ṛṣis, to whom Sauti related the Mahābhārata. E. निमिष a twinkling of an eye, in which the sage GAURAMUKHA destroyed a sort of Asuras, and अण् aff. and अरण्य forest.
नैमेय: नैमेय m. (-यः) Barter, exchange. E. नि before मि to measure, अच् aff. and अण् added.
नैयग्रोध: नैयग्रोध n. (-धं) The fruit of the Indian fig, &c. E. न्यग्रोध the fig tree, &c. and अण् aff.
नैयङ्कव: नैयङ्कव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Made of the skin, &c. of the deer, called न्यङ्क. E. न्यङ्कु, and अण् aff.
नैयत्य: नैयत्य n. (-त्यं) Self-government or subjugation. E. नियत, and ष्पञ् aff.
नैयमिक: नैयमिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) According to rule, regular, enjoined. E. नियम, and ठञ् aff.
नैयायिक: नैयायिक m. (-कः) A logician, a follower of the Nyāya or logical philosophy. E. न्याय the Nyāya system, and ठक् aff.
नैरन्तर्य: नैरन्तर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Compactness, closeness, contiguity. E. निरन्तर, and ष्यञ् aff.
नैरन्तर्य्य: नैरन्तर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Compactness, closeness, contiguity. E. निरन्तर, and ष्यञ् aff.
नैराश्य: नैराश्य n. (-श्यं) Despair. E. निराश, and ष्यञ् aff.
नैरृत: नैरृत m. (-तः) 1 A demon, a fiend. 2 The ruler of the south-west quarter. f. (-ती) The south-west quarter. E. निरृति said to be a proper name, and अञ् aff.
नैरुक्त: नैरुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ती-क्तं) 1 Obsolete, uncommon, belonging to the glossary of the Vedas. 2 Acquainted with the terms of the Vedas. E. निरुक्ति, and अण् aff.
नैर्गुण्य: नैर्गुण्य n. (-ण्यं) Absence of qualities or properties. E. निर्गुण, and ष्यञ् aff.
नैर्मल्य: नैर्मल्य n. (-ल्यं) Cleanness, purity. E. निर्मल, and ष्यञ् aff.
नैल्य: नैल्य n. (-ल्यं) Blueness, darkness of colour. E. नील, and ष्यञ् aff.
नैविड्य: नैविड्य n. (-ड्यं) 1 Thickness, substance. 2 Closeness, compactness. 3 Continued sound. E. निविड thick, &c. ष्यञ् aff.
नैवेद्य: नैवेद्य n. (-द्यं) An offering of eatable articles presented to a deity, which may afterwards be distributed to his ministers or worshippers, especially when it has been presented to any form of VIṢṆU. E. निवेद presenting, offering, ष्यञ् aff.
नैवेशिक: नैवेशिक n. (-कं) A present to a Brahman who is a householder, a girl so given, or ornaments with her, &c. E. निवेश a house, aff. ठञ्.
नैश: नैश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Nocturnal, relating to the night; or a person, &c. doing any thing by night. E. निशा night, and अण् aff.; also with ठञ् aff. नैशिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं.)
नैश्चित्य: नैश्चित्य n. (-त्यं) 1 Certainty. 2 A fixed festival; as at birth, investiture, marriage, &c. E. निश्चित, certain, ष्यञ् aff.
नैषध: नैषध mfn. (-धः-धी-धं) Relating to NIṢADHA. m. (-धः) A name of NALA. E. निषध the country so called, aff. अण्,
नैष्कर्म्म्य: नैष्कर्म्म्य n. (-र्म्मां) 1 Abstinence or exemption from acts or their consequences. 2 The salvation obtained by abstraction in opposition to that obtained by works. E. निष्कर्म्मन्, and ष्यञ् aff.
नैष्कशतिक: नैष्कशतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Worth a hundred Niṣkas, bought with them, &c. E. निष्क, and शत a hundred, ठञ् aff.; also with सहस्र a thousand नैष्कसहस्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
नैष्किक: नैष्किक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Bought with, made of, &c. a Niṣka. m. (-कः) The mint-master. E. निष्क a weight of gold, and ठक् aff.
नैष्कृतिक: नैष्कृतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Wicked, evil doing, malignant. E. निष्कृति, and ठक् aff.
नैष्ठिक: नैष्ठिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Relating to state or condition. 2 Belonging to the character or office of a perpetual student. 3 Firm, fixed. m. (-कः) The Brahman who continues with his spiritual preceptor, and always remains in the condition of the religious student. E. निष्ठा certainty, ठक् aff.
नैष्ठुर्य: नैष्ठुर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Severity, cruelty. E. निष्ठुर, and ष्यञ् aff.
नैष्ठुर्य्य: नैष्ठुर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Severity, cruelty. E. निष्ठुर, and ष्यञ् aff.
नैसर्गिक: नैसर्गिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Natural, innate. E. निसर्ग nature, ठक् aff.
नैस्त्रिंशिक: नैस्त्रिंशिक m. (-कः) A swordsman, a soldier armed with a sword. E. निस्त्रिंश a sword, aff. ठक्.
नो: नो ind. No, not. E. णुद to command, aff. डो.
नोधास्: नोधास् m. (-धाः) The name of a saint. E. नु to praise, असि Uṇādi aff. and धुट augment.
नोपस्थातृ: नोपस्थातृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Remote, far off. E. न negative, उप near, स्था to be, aff. तृच्.
नौ: नौ f. (नौः) A boat, a vessel in general. E. नुद to send, Uṇādi aff. डौ.
नौका: नौका f. (-का) A boat. E. कन् added to the preceding.
नौकादण्ड: नौकादण्ड m. (-ण्डः) An oar, a paddle. E. नौका a boat, and दण्ड a stick.
नौतार्य: नौतार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Navigable, to be gone to or traversed in a vessel. E. नौ, and तार्य्य to be crossed.
नौतार्य्य: नौतार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Navigable, to be gone to or traversed in a vessel. E. नौ, and तार्य्य to be crossed.
नौयायिन्: नौयायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) A passenger, a freight, who or what goes in a boat or vessel. E. नौ, and यायिन् who goes.
न्यक्: न्यक् ind. A particle of abuse or contempt. E. the neuter of न्यञ्च् used as a particle.
न्यक्करण: न्यक्करण n. (-णं) Treating with disrespect or contempt. E. न्यक्, and करण making.
न्यक्कार: न्यक्कार m. (-रः) Contempt, disrespect. E. न्यङ् little, low, कृ to make, aff. घञ्.
न्यक्कारुका: न्यक्कारुका f. (-का) An insect found in ordure.
न्यक्ष: न्यक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) 1 Whole, entire. 2 Low, inferior. m. (-क्षः) 1 A name of PARAŚURĀMA. 2 A buffalo. n. (-क्षं) 1 A hole. 2 Grass. E. नि before अक्ष a die, &c.
न्यग्जाति: न्यग्जाति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Of mean or inferior race. E. न्यक्, and जाति cast.
न्यग्भावन: न्यग्भावन m. (-नः) 1 Contempt. 2 Defiling. E. न्धक्, and भावन conceiving.
न्यग्रोध: न्यग्रोध m. (-धः) 1 The Indian fig tree, (Ficus Indica.) 2 A fathom measured by the arms extended. 3 The Śami, (Mimosa albida.) f. (-धी) 1 A plant, (Salvinia cucullata, Rox.) 2 A medical plant, commonly Mohānā. E. न्यक् short, रुध to impede, aff. अण्.
न्यङ्कु: न्यङ्कु m. (-ङ्कुः) 1 A deer. 2 The name of a saint or Muni. E. नि always, अञ्च to go, aff. कु.
न्यङ्कुभूरुह: न्यङ्कुभूरुह m. (-हः) A tree, (Cassia fistula.) E. न्यङ्कु a deer, and भूरुह a tree.
न्यङ्ग: न्यङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) Low abuse. E. न्यङ्, and ग what goes or is.
न्यञ्च्: न्यञ्च् mfn. (न्यङ् नीची न्यक्) 1 Short, dwarfish. 2 Low, vile, contemptible, base. 3 Slow, lazy. 4 Whole, entire. E. नि prefixed to अञ्च to go, aff. क्विप्.
न्यञ्चित: न्यञ्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Thrown or cast down. E. नि before, अञ्चित gone.
न्यय: न्यय m. (-यः) Loss, expense, waste, destruction. E. नि before इ to go, aff. अच्.
न्यर्ण: न्यर्ण्ण mfn. (-र्ण्णः-र्ण्णा-र्ण्णं) 1 Asked, solicited. 2 Gone. 3 Injured. E. नि, अर्द्द to ask, क्त aff.
न्यर्ण्ण: न्यर्ण्ण mfn. (-र्ण्णः-र्ण्णा-र्ण्णं) 1 Asked, solicited. 2 Gone. 3 Injured. E. नि, अर्द्द to ask, क्त aff.
न्यसन: न्यसन n. (-नं) 1 Delivering, giving up. 2 Depositing. E. नि before अस to throw, ल्युट् aff.
न्यस्त: न्यस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Deposited, consigned, delivered. 2 Placed in or upon. 3 Applied to. E. नि before अस to throw or send, aff. क्त.
न्यस्तशस्त्र: न्यस्तशस्त्र mfn. (-स्त्रः-स्त्रा-स्त्रं) Unarmed, defenceless, having laid down or resigned weapons. m. (-स्त्रः) A deified progenitor. E. न्यस्त delivered, and शस्त्र a weapon.
न्याद: न्याद m. (-दः) Eating, feeding. E. नि before अद to eat, अण aff.
न्याय: न्याय m. (-यः) 1 Propriety, fitness. 2 The Nyāya doctrine, logic, logical philosophy. 3 Apposite illustration. 4 A complete argument or syllogism. 5 Policy, good government. E. नि certainly, इन् to go, aff घञ्.
न्यायता: न्यायता f. (-ता) Fitness, propriety. E. तल् added to न्याय; also with त्व न्यायत्वं.
न्यायसारिणी: न्यायसारिणी f. (-णी) A woman acting or judging rightly. E. न्याय propriety, सारिणी proceeding.
न्यायाचार: न्यायाचार m. (-रः) A virtuous man. E. न्याय, and आचार observance.
न्यायाधार: न्यायाधार m. (-रः) An example of virtue or propriety. E. न्याय, and आधार what upholds.
न्यायिन्: न्यायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) 1 Right, fit. 2 Logical. E. न्याय, and इनि aff.
न्याय्य: न्याय्य mfn. (-य्यः-य्या-य्यं) Right, proper, fit. E. न्याय, and यत् aff.
न्यास: न्यास m. (-सः) 1 A deposit, a pledge. 2 Deserting, abandoning. 3 Delivering, presenting. 4 Mental delivering, consigning or entrusting any thing to the mind. 5 Mental appropriation or assignment of various parts of the body to tutelary divinities, accompanied with certain prayers and gesticulations. E. नि before अस to throw or cast away, aff. घञ्.
न्यासधारिन्: न्यासधारिन् m. (-री) The holder of a deposit, a mortgagee. E. न्यास, and धारिन् who has.
न्युङ्ख: न्युङ्ख m. (-ङ्खः) 1 Six-fold repetition of the triliteral name of God. 2 The Sāma Veda. 3 Pleasing, agreeable E. नि before उखि to go, aff. घ; it is also read न्युङ्ख.
न्युब्ज: न्युब्ज mfn. (-ब्जः-ब्जा-ब्जं) 1 Crooked-backed, hump-backed. 2 Looking downwards. 3 Bent, crooked. 4 Convex. m. (-ब्जः) 1 Disease, sickness, pain. 2 A sort of ladle made of Kusa grass. n. (-ब्जं) 1 The fruit of the Kāmaraṅga, (Carambola averrhoa.) 2 A vessel used at Śrāddhas. E. न्युब्ज to be crooked, aff. घञ्.
न्युब्जखड्ग: न्युब्जखड्ग m. (-ड्गः) A sabre, a crooked sword. E. न्युब्ज crooked, and खड्ग a sword.
न्यून: न्यून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Blameable, vile, wicked, despicable. 2 Less, deficient, defective. E. नि before ऊन less.
न्यूनता: न्यूनता f. (-ता) 1 Deficiency. 2 Inferiority. E. तल् added to न्यून also न्यूनत्व.
न्यूनधी: न्यूनधी mfn. (-धीः-धीः-धि) Ignorant, foolish. E. न्यून and धी intellect.
न्यूनपञ्चाशद्भाव: न्यूनपञ्चाशद्भाव m. (-वः) An ideot. E. न्यून, and पञ्चाशत् fifty, भाव property, having but forty-nine properties of human nature.
न्यूनाङ्ग: न्यूनाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Maimed, mutilated, imperfect. E. न्यून, and अङ्ग body.
न्यूनाधिक: न्यूनाधिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Unequal, more or less. E. न्यून, and अधिक more.
न्यूनाधिकविभाग: न्यूनाधिकविभाग m. (-गः) Unequal partition. E. न्यूनाधिक, and विभाग division.
न्यूनेन्द्रिय: न्यूनेन्द्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Imperfect, wanting some organ; as blind, deaf, &c. E. न्यून, and इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.
न्रस्थिमालिन्: न्रस्थिमालिन् m. (-ली) A name of ŚIVA. E. नृ man, अस्थि a bone, माला a necklace, and इनि poss. aff.; ornamented with a garland of human skulls. प
